recipes.title: 20-Minute Chicken Creole
recipes.summary: This quick Southern-style dish contains no added fat and very little added salt in its spicy tomato sauce.
recipes.license: Public domain (U.S. federal government work, 17 U.S.C. § 105)
recipes.attribution: Recipe from "Deliciously Healthy Dinners", National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute, National Institutes of Health.

ingredients.text: 12 oz boneless, skinless chicken breast, cut into thin strips
1 C canned whole peeled tomatoes, chopped
1 C chili sauce (look for lowest sodium version)
1½ C green bell pepper, rinsed and chopped
1 Tbsp fresh basil, rinsed, dried, and chopped (or 1 tsp dried)
1 Tbsp fresh parsley, rinsed, dried, and chopped (or 1 tsp dried)

steps: Spray sauté pan with cooking spray. Preheat over high heat.
Cook chicken in hot sauté pan, stirring for 3–5 minutes. Reduce heat.
Add tomatoes with juice, chili sauce, green pepper, celery, onion, garlic, basil, parsley, crushed red pepper, and salt. Bring to boil over high heat, and then reduce heat to simmer.
Simmer, covered, for 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Alaska Salmon Salad
recipes.summary: Easy, quick, and tasty — plus, fresh salmon is naturally low in sodium.
recipes.source: NHLBI (NIH), Honoring the Gift of Heart Health Manual for American Indians and Native Alaskans
recipes.license: Public domain (U.S. federal government work, 17 U.S.C. § 105)
recipes.attribution: Recipe from "Honoring the Gift of Heart Health Manual for American Indians and Native Alaskans", National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute, National Institutes of Health.

ingredients.note: Alaska salmon: USDA pink salmon used

steps: Bake fresh, unsalted salmon (until it flakes easily with a fork in the thickest part). Flake, place in a bowl, and chill.
After salmon has chilled, stir in the remaining ingredients.
Season with black pepper to taste.
Serve as a side dish or salad, or spread on pilot bread or unsalted crackers.

recipes.title: American Potato Salad I
recipes.attribution: "American Potato Salad I" by Wikibooks contributors (https://en.wikibooks.org/w/index.php?title=Cookbook%3AAmerican_Potato_Salad_I&action=history), revision 4630231, CC BY-SA 4.0. Ingredient matching and nutrition added by LeanTrack.
steps: Peel and cut potatoes into ¾ inch cubes.
Cover potatoes with an inch of water in a large saucepan and bring to a boil.
Add 1 tablespoon salt to boiling water and reduce heat to medium.
Simmer about 8 minutes, stirring gently once or twice, until potatoes are tender. Taste a piece—don't overcook.
Drain potatoes and place in a large bowl.
Toss potatoes gently with vinegar using a rubber spatula.
Cool potatoes. They must be no more than barely warm to mix.
Chop celery fine.
Stir together celery, celery seeds, mayonnaise, dry mustard, onion, parsley, pepper, and ½ teaspoon salt.
Gently fold together dressing mix and potatoes.
Cover and refrigerate at least an hour, until thoroughly chilled.

recipes.title: Apple Coffee Cake
recipes.summary: Tart apples and raisins make for a moist, delicious cake.
recipes.license: Public domain (U.S. federal government work, 17 U.S.C. § 105)
recipes.attribution: Recipe from "Stay Young At Heart", National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute, National Institutes of Health.

ingredients.text: 5 C tart apples, cored, peeled, and chopped

steps: Preheat oven to 350 °F. Lightly oil a 13×9×2-inch pan.
In a large mixing bowl, combine apples with sugar, raisins, and pecans; mix well. Let stand for 30 minutes.
Stir in oil, vanilla, and egg. Sift together flour, baking soda, and cinnamon; stir into apple mixture about 1/3 at a time, stirring just enough to moisten dry ingredients.
Turn batter into pan. Bake 35 to 40 minutes, until a toothpick inserted in the center of the cake comes out clean.
Cool cake slightly before serving.

recipes.title: Asian-Style Steamed Salmon
recipes.summary: Enjoy this simple, fast dish any weeknight.
recipes.license: Public domain (U.S. federal government work, 17 U.S.C. § 105)
recipes.attribution: Recipe from "Deliciously Healthy Dinners", National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute, National Institutes of Health.

ingredients.text: ½ C shiitake mushroom caps, rinsed and sliced (or substitute dried shiitake mushrooms)
2 Tbsp fresh ginger, minced (or 2 tsp ground)
¼ C scallions (green onions), rinsed and chopped
12 oz salmon fillet, cut into 4 portions (3 oz each)

steps: Combine chicken broth, mushroom caps, ginger, scallions, soy sauce, and sesame oil (optional) in a large, shallow sauté pan. Bring to a boil over high heat, then lower heat and simmer for 2–3 minutes.

Add salmon fillets, and cover with a tight-fitting lid. Cook gently over low heat for 4–5 minutes or until the salmon flakes easily with a fork in the thickest part (to a minimum internal temperature of 145 °F).
Serve one piece of salmon with ¼ cup of broth.

recipes.title: Asparagus Soup
recipes.attribution: "Asparagus Soup" by Wikibooks contributors (https://en.wikibooks.org/w/index.php?title=Cookbook%3AAsparagus_Soup&action=history), revision 4523683, CC BY-SA 4.0. Ingredient matching and nutrition added by LeanTrack.

ingredients.note: USDA has no weight for a whole shallot (not counted, about 20 kcal)

ingredients.text: ¼–1 cup whipping or light cream
Salt, freshly ground black pepper, and cayenne pepper to taste

steps: Snap the tough ends off the asparagus spears.

Bring the water to a boil in a medium saucepan, salt the water lightly, and add the asparagus spears. Cook at a lively simmer for 10 minutes. Lift out with tongs and set aside. Reserve the cooking water.

In a separate saucepan large enough to hold the finished soup, heat the butter, add the chopped shallot, and cook gently until soft but not browned. Add the cooked asparagus spears and one cup of the cooking water and bring to a boil. Cook at a lively simmer for 5 minutes. Remove from the heat and strain the soup through a medium sieve into a bowl, reserving the liquid.
Purée the solids in a food processor with enough of the reserved liquid to allow the mixture to purée smoothly.

Strain the purée through the sieve back into the non-reactive saucepan, rubbing the mixture through with a flexible scraper or wooden spoon and leaving the fibrous parts in the sieve. Discard the contents of the sieve.

Add the cream and enough of the remaining asparagus cooking water to give the soup the consistency you want. Season to taste with salt, freshly ground black pepper, and cayenne pepper. Reheat gently over low heat, making sure not to let the soup boil.
Serve hot or chilled. If you want to serve it chilled, let it cool, then refrigerate it uncovered until thoroughly cold, then cover with plastic wrap. You can keep it refrigerated for up to 2 days.

recipes.title: Asparagus With Lemon Sauce
recipes.summary: Lemon sauce makes fresh asparagus the perfect side dish for fish, scallops, chicken, or meat dishes.
recipes.license: Public domain (U.S. federal government work, 17 U.S.C. § 105)
recipes.attribution: Recipe from "Deliciously Healthy Dinners", National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute, National Institutes of Health.

ingredients.text: 20 medium asparagus spears, rinsed and trimmed
1 fresh lemon, rinsed (for peel and juice)

steps: Place 1 inch of water in a 4-quart pot with a lid. Place a steamer basket inside the pot, and add asparagus. Cover and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat to medium. Cook for 5–10 minutes, until asparagus is easily pierced with a sharp knife. Do not overcook.

While the asparagus cooks, grate the lemon zest into a small bowl. Cut the lemon in half and squeeze the juice into the bowl. Use the back of a spoon to press out extra juice and remove pits. Add mayonnaise, parsley, pepper, and salt. Stir well. Set aside.
When the asparagus is tender, remove the pot from the heat. Place asparagus spears in a serving bowl. Drizzle the lemon sauce evenly over the asparagus (about 1½ teaspoons per portion) and serve.

recipes.title: Autumn Salad
recipes.summary: Fruit and nuts make this salad a fun starter or side to most main-dish meals...and it can be served year round!
recipes.license: Public domain (U.S. federal government work, 17 U.S.C. § 105)
recipes.attribution: Recipe from "Deliciously Healthy Dinners", National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute, National Institutes of Health.

ingredients.text: 1 Granny Smith apple, rinsed and sliced thinly (with skin)
1 bag mixed lettuce greens (or your favorite lettuce) (about 5 C), rinsed
⅓ C low-fat raspberry vinaigrette dressing

steps: Sprinkle lemon juice on the apple slices.
Mix the lettuce, cranberries, apple, walnuts, and sunflower seeds in a bowl.
Toss with raspberry vinaigrette dressing, to lightly cover the salad, and serve.

recipes.title: Baby Spinach With Golden Raisins and Pine Nuts
recipes.summary: Sweet golden raisins and crunchy pine nuts make this a fabulous way to get your spinach.
recipes.license: Public domain (U.S. federal government work, 17 U.S.C. § 105)
recipes.attribution: Recipe from "Deliciously Healthy Dinners", National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute, National Institutes of Health.

ingredients.text: 2 bags (10 oz each) leaf spinach, rinsed

steps: In a medium nonstick pan over high heat, cook and stir the pine nuts until they begin to brown lightly and smell toasted, but not burnt. Set the pine nuts aside in another dish.

Return the pan to the burner over medium-high heat. Add ¼ cup water. As it begins to boil, add a small handful of the spinach. Cook and stir just until it begins to wilt. Then push it to the side of the pan, and add another ¼ cup water and handful of spinach. Continue until all the spinach has been cooked, adding the raisins with the last handful of spinach.
Sprinkle with nutmeg and salt. Cook and stir until all the spinach is wilted and the raisins are warm.
Remove from heat. Press out excess water. Place 1 cup spinach and raisins in a serving bowl. Top with pine nuts.

recipes.title: Baked Fish
recipes.summary: This heart-healthy dish can be made with many kinds of fish — to be enjoyed over and over.
recipes.source: NHLBI (NIH), Heart Healthy Home Cooking African American Style
recipes.license: Public domain (U.S. federal government work, 17 U.S.C. § 105)
recipes.attribution: Recipe from "Heart Healthy Home Cooking African American Style", National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute, National Institutes of Health.

ingredients.text: ¼ C fat-free or 1 percent buttermilk
½ C cornflakes, crumbled, or regular bread crumbs

steps: Preheat oven to 475 °F.
Drizzle lemon juice on fish. Then, pat dry.
Combine milk, hot sauce, and garlic in a mixing bowl.
Combine white pepper, salt, and onion powder with cornflakes, and spread on a plate.
Let fillets sit briefly in milk mixture. Remove a fillet, coat on both sides with seasoned crumbs, and let stand briefly until coating sticks to each side of fish. Repeat for all fillets.
Arrange fillets on a lightly oiled shallow baking dish.
Bake for 20 minutes on middle rack without turning.
Cut into 6 pieces. Serve with fresh lemon.

recipes.title: Baked French Fries
recipes.summary: Oven baking makes these french fries lower in fat and still crispy.
recipes.license: Public domain (U.S. federal government work, 17 U.S.C. § 105)
recipes.attribution: Recipe from "Stay Young At Heart", National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute, National Institutes of Health.
steps: Scrub potatoes and cut them into long ½-inch strips. Place the strips in the ice water, cover, and chill for 1 hour or longer.
Remove potato strips and dry them thoroughly. Preheat oven to 475 °F.
Place garlic powder, onion powder, salt, white pepper, allspice, and pepper flakes in a plastic bag. Toss the potato strips in the spice mixture.
Put the potato strips in a shallow baking pan, and brush them with oil.
Cover the baking pan with aluminum foil, and bake at 475 °F for 15 minutes.
Remove the foil, and continue baking, uncovered, for an additional 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown. Turn fries occasionally to brown on all sides.

recipes.title: Baked Lemon Thyme Halibut
recipes.attribution: "Baked Lemon Thyme Halibut" by Wikibooks contributors (https://en.wikibooks.org/w/index.php?title=Cookbook%3ABaked_Lemon_Thyme_Halibut&action=history), revision 4511873, CC BY-SA 4.0. Ingredient matching and nutrition added by LeanTrack.
steps: Place the fish in the center of the baking pan.
Drizzle fish with olive oil and fish stock. Add thyme sprigs, slices of lemon, and sprinkle with pepper. Cover with parchment paper and foil.
Bake in oven on sheet pan at 400 °F (200 °C) for 15–20 minutes until flesh is flaky.

recipes.title: Baked Salmon Dijon
recipes.summary: This salmon entree is easy to make and will be enjoyed by the whole family.
recipes.license: Public domain (U.S. federal government work, 17 U.S.C. § 105)
recipes.attribution: Recipe from "Deliciously Healthy Dinners", National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute, National Institutes of Health.

ingredients.text: 3 Tbsp scallions (green onions), rinsed and finely chopped
1½ lb salmon fillet, cut into 6 portions (4 oz each)

steps: Preheat oven to 400 °F.
Whisk sour cream, dill, scallions, mustard, and lemon juice in a small bowl to blend.
Lightly coat baking sheet with cooking spray.
Place salmon, skin side down, on the prepared baking sheet. Sprinkle with garlic powder and pepper, then spread with sauce.
Bake salmon fillets until each is opaque in the center and flakes easily with a fork in the thickest part, about 20 minutes (to a minimum internal temperature of 145 °F).
Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Baked Tilapia With Tomatoes
recipes.summary: This dish is easy to prepare, low in calories, and economical.
recipes.source: NHLBI (NIH), Delicious Heart Healthy Latino Recipes
recipes.license: Public domain (U.S. federal government work, 17 U.S.C. § 105)
recipes.attribution: Recipe from "Delicious Heart Healthy Latino Recipes", National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute, National Institutes of Health.

ingredients.text: ¼ C pitted black olives, diced
Parsley and lemon wedges for garnish

steps: Preheat oven to 400 °F.
Spray baking dish with cooking spray.
Arrange fillets in the baking dish. The dish should be large enough so the fillets do not overlap.
Mix remaining ingredients, except parsley and lemon wedges, in a bowl.
Spoon the tomato mixture evenly over the fillets.
Bake uncovered 15 to 20 minutes or until the fish flakes easily with a fork.
Garnish with parsley and a lemon wedge, and serve.

recipes.title: Banana Bread with Walnuts
recipes.attribution: "Banana Bread with Walnuts" by Wikibooks contributors (https://en.wikibooks.org/w/index.php?title=Cookbook%3ABanana_Bread_with_Walnuts&action=history), revision 4541035, CC BY-SA 4.0. Ingredient matching and nutrition added by LeanTrack.

ingredients.note: amount not given in the source (not counted)

steps: Combine the flour, baking powder, and salt.
Cream the butter and sugar together until light and fluffy.
Whisk the eggs, and gradually beat them into the butter mixture.
Mix in one third of the flour mixture, followed by half the banana. Continue alternating in this way until all the dry mixture and mashed banana is incorporated.
Stir in the walnuts.
Grease and line 2 loaf pans. Divide batter evenly between pans. Sprinkle the tops with additional turbinado sugar.

Bake at 350°F for at least 1 hour. After this point, check the banana bread every 10 minutes or so until it is done. It will be browned, and a skewer inserted into the center of the loaf should come out clean with no more than moist crumbs attached.
Let cool to room temperature in the pans. Unmold.

recipes.title: Banana Pancakes
recipes.attribution: "Banana Pancakes" by Wikibooks contributors (https://en.wikibooks.org/w/index.php?title=Cookbook%3ABanana_Pancakes&action=history), revision 4523328, CC BY-SA 4.0. Ingredient matching and nutrition added by LeanTrack.

ingredients.text: 300 grams self-raising flour (or 300 grams all-purpose flour + 1 tablespoon baking powder)

steps: Melt the butter in a medium-size heat-safe mixing bowl.
Add the bananas, and mash the bananas and butter together with a potato masher.
Add the eggs and continue to mash until smooth.
Gradually stir in the milk with a wooden spoon.
In a separate large bowl, whisk together the dry ingredients.
Slowly mix the wet ingredients into the dry to get a batter.
Heat a nonstick skillet over medium heat.
For each round of frying, grease the pan with a little extra butter. Pour about ⅓ cup of batter onto the pan for each pancake, making sure they don't run into each other.
Cook the pancakes on on medium-low heat for about 3 minutes on each side until the side is lightly browned. You can tell if it's time to turn the pancake if you can see bubbles on the other side.
Flip the pancakes using a spatula, and cook through on the other side.
Remove the pancakes from the pan, and repeat the cooking process with the remaining batter.

recipes.title: Basic Scrambled Eggs
recipes.attribution: "Basic Scrambled Eggs" by Wikibooks contributors (https://en.wikibooks.org/w/index.php?title=Cookbook%3ABasic_Scrambled_Eggs&action=history), revision 4523414, CC BY-SA 4.0. Ingredient matching and nutrition added by LeanTrack.

ingredients.text: ⅛ tsp black pepper (or to taste)

steps: Crack eggs into a measuring cup.
Add the milk (if desired) and salt.
Using a whisk or fork, beat the mixture until foamy.
Melt butter in a frying pan on medium heat
Pour eggs into frying pan.
Stir mixture to break up the egg as it cooks and allow more liquid to touch the hot pan. Stirring rapidly will create small curds, while slower stirring will create larger curds.

Cook until just before you feel that they are done, since the eggs will continue to cook after being removed from the pan. The eggs are done when the sheen disappears; stop cooking just before this happens.
Transfer to a plate. Season with black pepper (black pepper will burn and become bitter if seasoned before cooking).
Eat as is or with ketchup (tomato sauce), salsa, and/or butter on toast.

recipes.title: Bean Chili
recipes.attribution: "Bean Chili" by Wikibooks contributors (https://en.wikibooks.org/w/index.php?title=Cookbook%3ABean_Chili&action=history), revision 4518540, CC BY-SA 4.0. Ingredient matching and nutrition added by LeanTrack.

ingredients.text: 2 tbsp olive oil or vegetable oil
1 tsp thyme, basil, oregano, or other spice

steps: Heat oil over medium-high heat in a large pot.
Add garlic and onion and cook until the onion is translucent (more clear than white).
Add peppers and sauté for a few minutes. Add crushed tomatoes, tomato paste, and spices.
When mixture is bubbling, reduce heat to simmer and add beans. Cover and simmer for at least 1 hour, stirring occasionally. The longer it simmers, the better it tastes.

recipes.title: Black Bean Chili
recipes.attribution: "Black Bean Chili" by Wikibooks contributors (https://en.wikibooks.org/w/index.php?title=Cookbook%3ABlack_Bean_Chili&action=history), revision 4523913, CC BY-SA 4.0. Ingredient matching and nutrition added by LeanTrack.

ingredients.text: 2 tablespoons (30 mL) corn oil or other vegetable oil
2 tablespoons (30 mL) wine vinegar (red or white)

steps: Place beans in a large pot, add with enough water to cover by 2 inches (2.5 cm), and allow to soak overnight. Drain beans and cover again with fresh water. Bring to boil, reduce heat, and simmer for 2 hours.

Heat the corn oil in a stockpot or other very large pot over medium-high heat. Add the onions and sauté until tender, about 3 minutes. Add garlic, chipotle and ancho chiles, cumin, paprika, oregano, salt, cayenne, and vinegar, and sauté for 5 to 10 minutes.
Add tomatoes, tomato puree, and the water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes. Add the beans with their juice. Simmer for 1 hour.
Serve with or without sour cream.

recipes.title: Black Bean Soup
recipes.attribution: "Black Bean Soup" by Wikibooks contributors (https://en.wikibooks.org/w/index.php?title=Cookbook%3ABlack_Bean_Soup&action=history), revision 4524842, CC BY-SA 4.0. Ingredient matching and nutrition added by LeanTrack.
steps: Pick over the beans.
Place in large bean pot and add water to cover by at least 2 inches (~5 cm).
Soak overnight, then change water.
Bring beans to a boil. Reduce heat, then simmer until beans start to soften, around ½ hour.
Add bay leaves, bell peppers, chili powder, cumin, garlic, jalapeños, onions, and red wine vinegar.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
Simmer ½ to 1 hour, until beans are soft.
Take out bay leaves.
Stir in cilantro.
Add some sour cream.
Serve.

recipes.title: Braised Cod With Leeks
recipes.summary: A simple, but elegant, weeknight meal.
recipes.license: Public domain (U.S. federal government work, 17 U.S.C. § 105)
recipes.attribution: Recipe from "Deliciously Healthy Dinners", National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute, National Institutes of Health.
recipes.servingSize: 3 oz cod, 1½ C broth and vegetables

ingredients.text: 2 C leeks, split lengthwise, sliced thin, and rinsed well
3 medium carrots, rinsed, peeled, and cut into thin sticks
4 new (red) potatoes, rinsed and sliced into ½-inch thick circles
2 Tbsp fresh parsley, rinsed, dried, and chopped (or 2 tsp dried)
12 oz cod fillets, cut into 4 portions (3 oz each)

steps: Heat butter in a large sauté pan. Add leeks and carrots, and cook gently for 3–5 minutes, stirring often, until the vegetables begin to soften.
Add potatoes, chicken broth, parsley, and salt and pepper, and bring to a boil over high heat. Reduce heat and simmer gently until the vegetables are just tender, about 10–12 minutes.

Add cod fillets, and cover with a tight-fitting lid. Continue cooking over low heat for an additional 5 minutes or until the fish is white and flakes easily with a fork in the thickest part (to a minimum internal temperature of 145 °F).
Serve each cod fillet with 1½ cups broth and vegetables.

recipes.title: Bran Muffins
recipes.attribution: "Bran Muffins" by Wikibooks contributors (https://en.wikibooks.org/w/index.php?title=Cookbook%3ABran_Muffins&action=history), revision 4515901, CC BY-SA 4.0. Ingredient matching and nutrition added by LeanTrack.
steps: Stir wheat bran and buttermilk together in a mixing bowl.
Cream together egg, brown sugar and margarine in another mixing bowl.
Combine remaining ingredients in a third bowl. Add to batter, and stir just to moisten.
Fill muffin cups ¾ full.
Bake at 400°F (200°C) for 15 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Brown Rice with Ground Turkey
recipes.attribution: "Brown Rice with Ground Turkey" by Wikibooks contributors (https://en.wikibooks.org/w/index.php?title=Cookbook%3ABrown_Rice_with_Ground_Turkey&action=history), revision 4512901, CC BY-SA 4.0. Ingredient matching and nutrition added by LeanTrack.

ingredients.text: 20 ounces of extra lean ground turkey breast
1 can (12 ounces) diced tomatoes with green chiles
Seasonings to taste (e.g. garlic powder, lemon pepper, allspice, etc.)

steps: Spray skillet with cooking spray, and sprinkle in garlic powder and other seasonings. Add turkey, and crumble it as it cooks. Add tomatoes, and mix with turkey until turkey is cooked.
Add cooking oil to a wok or deep skillet. Add 1 teaspoon allspice and/or other seasonings.
As pan heats slowly add cooked rice (watch for splattering of hot oil). When rice is heated evenly add teriyaki sauce, and mix it evenly.
When ground turkey is done cooking add it to rice in wok, mix it thoroughly, and serve.

recipes.title: Bulgogi
recipes.attribution: "Bulgogi" by Wikibooks contributors (https://en.wikibooks.org/w/index.php?title=Cookbook%3ABulgogi&action=history), revision 4610539, CC BY-SA 4.0. Ingredient matching and nutrition added by LeanTrack.

ingredients.text: 1 lb (450 g) beef suitable for grilling, sliced as thin as possible
3 green onions, sliced on the bias

steps: Combine all the ingredients in a big bowl. Marinate for at least 30 minutes, but marinating overnight will get the best flavor and tenderization.
Grill the beef.
Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Caribbean Pink Beans
recipes.summary: This dish stays healthy by using beans prepared without lard or other fat.
recipes.license: Public domain (U.S. federal government work, 17 U.S.C. § 105)
recipes.attribution: Recipe from "Deliciously Healthy Dinners", National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute, National Institutes of Health.

ingredients.text: 1 large tomato, rinsed and finely chopped
1 small red bell pepper, rinsed and finely chopped

steps: Rinse and pick through beans for rocks and other debris (discard these). Put beans in a large pot, and add 10 cups of water. Place pot in refrigerator, and allow beans to soak overnight.

Place the soaked and drained beans in a large pot with enough water to cover them by about 1 inch. Boil gently with lid tilted until beans are soft, about 1 hour. Add more water while beans are cooking if water level drops below the top of the beans.
Add plantains, tomato, red pepper, onion, garlic, and salt. Continue cooking at low heat until plantains are soft.
Serve warm.
tips: Try serving with a whole grain.

recipes.title: Carrot and Raisin Salad
recipes.attribution: "Carrot and Raisin Salad" by Wikibooks contributors (https://en.wikibooks.org/w/index.php?title=Cookbook%3ACarrot_and_Raisin_Salad&action=history), revision 4523446, CC BY-SA 4.0. Ingredient matching and nutrition added by LeanTrack.
steps: Mix carrots with raisins in a bowl.
Add approximately 1 teaspoon of finely-grated lemon and orange zest, then add the juices.
Add sugar or honey to taste, and toss everything together well.
Refrigerate and serve.

recipes.title: Chicken and Black-eyed Pea Stew
recipes.attribution: "Chicken and Black-eyed Pea Stew" by Wikibooks contributors (https://en.wikibooks.org/w/index.php?title=Cookbook%3AChicken_and_Black-eyed_Pea_Stew&action=history), revision 4518586, CC BY-SA 4.0. Ingredient matching and nutrition added by LeanTrack.

ingredients.text: 1 cup of dry black-eyed peas (or about 2 cups canned)
2–3 tbsp vegetable oil or chicken fat
2 medium (~2 cups) chopped white or red onions
1 stalk (~½–1 cup) chopped celery including the leaves
1 tsp black pepper, preferably freshly-crushed peppercorns
1 cup uncooked long-grained rice, preferably brown rice
2 cups chicken stock, canned tomato liquid, water, or vegetable stock
2 cups canned tomatoes (crushed or diced), or 1 pound diced fresh tomatoes.
1 pound bone-in chicken meat (e.g. two chicken legs)
2 tsp curry powder stirred into the juice of ½ lemon

steps: If using dry black-eyed peas, wash them, then cook for 20 minutes or until al dente. When done, drain.
Meanwhile, sauté onions, carrots, and celery in oil for 5 minutes.
Add garlic, ginger, salt, and pepper, and sauté for 2 more minutes.
Stir rice into vegetable mix.
Add stock and tomatoes, then bring to a boil.
Add the cooked black-eyed peas.
Add meat, cook a further 5 minutes, turn heat to low, and let simmer for 30–40 minutes. The stew is ready when the rice is soft.
Add chili peppers and curry-lemon paste, then cook for 10 more minutes. Serve hot.

recipes.title: Chicken and Mushroom Fricassee
recipes.summary: Fat-free sour cream, vegetables, and herbs make this rich and hearty dish guilt free.
recipes.license: Public domain (U.S. federal government work, 17 U.S.C. § 105)
recipes.attribution: Recipe from "Deliciously Healthy Dinners", National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute, National Institutes of Health.
recipes.servingSize: 1 chicken leg, 1 C vegetables and sauce

ingredients.text: 1 carton (10 oz) white button mushrooms, rinsed and quartered
1 C leeks, split into quarters, then sliced into small squares and rinsed well
1 C pearl onions, raw or frozen
1 lb skinless chicken legs or thighs (4 whole legs, split, or 8 thighs)
2 Tbsp each fresh herbs (such as parsley and chives), rinsed, dried, and minced (or 2 tsp dried)

steps: Preheat oven to 350 ºF.
Heat olive oil in a medium-sized heavy-bottom roasting or braising pan (a large sauté pan with a metal handle will work as well).

Add mushrooms to pan, and cook until golden brown, about 3–5 minutes. Add leeks, potatoes, celery, and pearl onions, and continue to cook until the vegetables become soft, about 3–5 additional minutes.

Add chicken broth to the pan, and bring to a boil. Add chicken legs to the pan, cover, and place in the heated oven for about 20 minutes or until the chicken legs are tender when pierced with a fork (to a minimum internal temperature of 165 °F).
When chicken legs are tender, remove legs from the pan, return the pan to the stovetop, and bring the liquid to a boil. Add herbs and lemon juice.
In a bowl, mix the cornstarch with the sour cream, and add to the pan. Bring back to a boil and then remove from the heat.
Season with salt and pepper, and pour 1 cup of vegetables and sauce over chicken.

recipes.title: Chicken Chile Stew
recipes.summary: The ultimate comfort food, with lower saturated fat and cholesterol.
recipes.source: NHLBI (NIH), Honoring the Gift of Heart Health Manual for American Indians and Native Alaskans
recipes.license: Public domain (U.S. federal government work, 17 U.S.C. § 105)
recipes.attribution: Recipe from "Honoring the Gift of Heart Health Manual for American Indians and Native Alaskans", National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute, National Institutes of Health.

ingredients.text: 3 lb boneless, skinless chicken (breast or leg), cubed
7 green chilies, roasted, peeled, seeded, and chopped

steps: Spray a heavy iron skillet with cooking spray, and preheat over medium heat. Brown the chicken cubes, in batches, with cooking spray as needed.
Place the meat in a 3- or 4-quart casserole (with cover), and add the remaining ingredients.
Deglaze the skillet: On high heat, add some cold water and scrape the hardened juices with a spoon or spatula to dissolve them into the water. Add the sauce to the casserole.
Add water to barely cover the ingredients. Cover the casserole, and simmer until the stew is thick and the meat is very tender, about 1½ hours.
Add black pepper to taste before serving.

recipes.title: Chicken Picadillo
recipes.summary: This zesty one-pot meal is easy to throw together on a busy weeknight.
recipes.license: Public domain (U.S. federal government work, 17 U.S.C. § 105)
recipes.attribution: Recipe from "Deliciously Healthy Dinners", National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute, National Institutes of Health.

ingredients.text: 1 medium green bell pepper, rinsed and finely chopped
1 medium red bell pepper, rinsed and finely chopped
12 oz boneless, skinless chicken breast, cut into thin strips
For garnish: 1 Tbsp fresh cilantro, rinsed, dried, and chopped (or substitute 1 tsp dried coriander)

steps: Heat olive oil in a large sauté pan over medium heat. Add the onion, bell peppers, and garlic, and sauté until vegetables are soft, about 5 minutes.
Add the chicken, and stir fry for another 5–10 minutes until chicken is no longer pink inside.
Add the tomato sauce, chicken broth, lemon juice, cumin, bay leaves, water, and raisins to the vegetables and chicken.
Cover the pan, and reduce the heat. Simmer for 10 minutes.
Remove the bay leaves, and garnish with fresh cilantro, capers, and green olives, and serve.
tips: Serve with brown rice and black beans.

recipes.title: Chicken Salad
recipes.summary: Flavorful, fast, and a great way to use leftover chicken!
recipes.license: Public domain (U.S. federal government work, 17 U.S.C. § 105)
recipes.attribution: Recipe from "Stay Young At Heart", National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute, National Institutes of Health.
steps: Bake chicken, cut into cubes, and refrigerate.
In a large bowl, combine the rest of the ingredients. Add chilled chicken, and mix well.
tips: To reduce sodium, omit the ⅛ tsp of added salt. New sodium content for each serving is 120 mg.

recipes.title: Chicken Tikka Masala
recipes.attribution: "Chicken Tikka Masala" by Wikibooks contributors (https://en.wikibooks.org/w/index.php?title=Cookbook%3AChicken_Tikka_Masala&action=history), revision 4614347, CC BY-SA 4.0. Ingredient matching and nutrition added by LeanTrack.

ingredients.text: 4 large cloves of garlic, finely chopped
1–4 chopped fresh green chiles (depending on strength of the chiles and the desired strength of the sauce)
1 tbsp malt vinegar or tamarind extract

ingredients.note: spice paste not in USDA data (not counted)
spice blend not in USDA data (not counted)

steps: Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan.
Add the garlic and onions and stir-fry until browned.
Add the curry pastes and mix well, adding a little water or yogurt.
Add the cooked chicken tikka, and stir-fry for two minutes to heat through.
Add the tomatoes, vinegar, tomato paste, and chilies and simmer for five minutes. Add more extra water if needed.
Add the cream, garam masala, and chopped cilantro and simmer for a few times.
Garnish with fresh coriander and serve with Naan, rice coloured yellow with turmeric, onion bahjis and/or a glass of white wine.

recipes.title: Chickpea Stew
recipes.attribution: "Chickpea Stew" by Wikibooks contributors (https://en.wikibooks.org/w/index.php?title=Cookbook%3AChickpea_Stew&action=history), revision 4518592, CC BY-SA 4.0. Ingredient matching and nutrition added by LeanTrack.

ingredients.text: 150 g of dry or 500 g of cooked chickpeas
6–8 medium tomatoes, chopped, or 2–3 cups of canned tomatoes
1 tsp soy sauce (optional, can use salt)
2 Tbsp cilantro sprig, finely chopped (optional, for garnish)

steps: If using dry chickpeas, wash, then soak for 12 hours, then cook 40–50 minutes until soft or for 8–10 minutes in a pressure cooker. If using a pressure cooker, do not depressurize but let the cool down; depressurizing causes the chickpeas to break open.
Cook onions in the broth until softened.
Add zucchini, tomatoes, bell pepper, chili pepper, and garlic and cook for 10–15 minutes, until peppers and zucchini are soft.
Start boiling the rice.
Add chickpeas, peanut butter, spices, and soy sauce. Keep simmering for 5–10 more minutes.
Sprinkle with cilantro garnish if desired, then serve immediately.

recipes.title: Chunky Guacamole
recipes.attribution: "Chunky Guacamole" by Wikibooks contributors (https://en.wikibooks.org/w/index.php?title=Cookbook%3AChunky_Guacamole&action=history), revision 4523970, CC BY-SA 4.0. Ingredient matching and nutrition added by LeanTrack.
steps: Peel and dice avocados.
Sprinkle the avocados with lime juice.
Add salsa fresca, and toss to mix.

recipes.title: Coconut Crusted Baked Cod
recipes.attribution: "Coconut Crusted Baked Cod" by Wikibooks contributors (https://en.wikibooks.org/w/index.php?title=Cookbook%3ACoconut_Crusted_Baked_Cod&action=history), revision 4531775, CC BY-SA 4.0. Ingredient matching and nutrition added by LeanTrack.
steps: In a bowl, combine coconut milk, soy sauce, sesame oil, pepper flakes, ginger, and pepper.
Marinate cod in this mixture for 15 minutes.
Place fillets on an oiled baking pan.
Bake at 350°F for 15 minutes or until flaky.
Garnish with coconut flakes and fresh mint.

recipes.title: Cold Fusilli Pasta with Summer Vegetables
recipes.summary: A whole new twist on pasta salad!
recipes.license: Public domain (U.S. federal government work, 17 U.S.C. § 105)
recipes.attribution: Recipe from "Deliciously Healthy Dinners", National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute, National Institutes of Health.

ingredients.text: 2 C cherry tomatoes, rinsed and halved
1 large green bell pepper, rinsed and sliced in pieces ¼ inch wide by 2 inches long
½ C red onion, thinly sliced
1 medium zucchini, rinsed and shredded finely or sliced into small chunks (about 1 C)
1 can (15½ oz) low-sodium chickpeas (or garbanzo beans), drained and rinsed
1 Tbsp fresh basil, rinsed, dried, and cut into thin strips (or 1 tsp dried)

steps: In a 4-quart saucepan, bring 3 quarts of water to a boil over high heat.
Add pasta, and cook according to package directions for the shortest recommended time, about 8–9 minutes. Drain. Rinse pasta under cold running water to cool, about 3 minutes.
Place all the vegetables and beans in a large salad serving bowl. Season with basil, salt, and pepper.
Add the cooled pasta.
Combine olive oil and vinegar in a small bowl. Mix until completely blended. Pour over vegetables and pasta. Mix gently until well coated.
Divide into four equal portions. Top each with 2 tablespoons shredded parmesan cheese.

recipes.title: Coleslaw I
recipes.attribution: "Coleslaw I" by Wikibooks contributors (https://en.wikibooks.org/w/index.php?title=Cookbook%3AColeslaw_I&action=history), revision 4630331, CC BY-SA 4.0. Ingredient matching and nutrition added by LeanTrack.

ingredients.text: 4 tablespoons mayonnaise or 2 dL olive oil

steps: If adding cider vinegar, add it to the mayonnaise and mix together well.
Slice or shred the cabbage, as coarsely or finely as desired.
In a large bowl, mix cabbage and onion together with mayonnaise.
Set aside to allow the flavours to merge at least 20 minutes but preferably for a couple of hours.

recipes.title: Couscous With Carrots, Walnuts, and Raisins
recipes.summary: This quick-cooking grain dish has a touch of sweet and nutty flavors to go with most main dishes.
recipes.license: Public domain (U.S. federal government work, 17 U.S.C. § 105)
recipes.attribution: Recipe from "Deliciously Healthy Dinners", National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute, National Institutes of Health.

ingredients.text: ½ tsp pumpkin pie spice or cinnamon
½ C carrots, rinsed, peeled, and shredded or thinly sliced; cut in half

steps: In a 4-quart saucepan over medium heat, cook and stir couscous, olive oil, walnuts, salt, pepper, and spice just until couscous begins to brown.
Slowly add water, then raisins and carrots. Cover. Bring to a boil over high heat.
Remove from the heat, and let stand for 10 minutes.
Fluff with a fork. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Creamy Squash Soup With Shredded Apples
recipes.summary: This easy-to-make soup will warm you up with flavor. Serve with a green salad and whole-wheat bread.
recipes.license: Public domain (U.S. federal government work, 17 U.S.C. § 105)
recipes.attribution: Recipe from "Deliciously Healthy Dinners", National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute, National Institutes of Health.

ingredients.text: 2 boxes (16 oz each) frozen pureed winter (butternut) squash
2 medium apples (try Golden Delicious or Gala)
2 cans (12 oz each) fat-free evaporated milk

steps: Place the frozen squash in a microwave-safe dish. Cover loosely. Defrost in the microwave on medium power for 5–10 minutes, until mostly thawed.
Meanwhile, peel then shred the apples using a grater or food processor, or peel and finely chop apples into thin strips. Set aside ¼ cup.
Warm oil in a 4-quart saucepan over medium heat. Add all but ¼ cup of the apples. Cook and stir until apples soften, about 5 minutes.
Stir in thawed squash and pumpkin pie spice.
Add the evaporated milk about ½ cup at a time, stirring after each addition.
Season with salt and pepper.
Cook and stir over high heat just until soup is about to boil.
Ladle into individual soup bowls. Top each with a tablespoon of the unused apples. Sprinkle with additional pumpkin pie spice, if desired.

recipes.title: Denver Omelet
recipes.attribution: "Denver Omelet" by Wikibooks contributors (https://en.wikibooks.org/w/index.php?title=Cookbook%3ADenver_Omelet&action=history), revision 4517799, CC BY-SA 4.0. Ingredient matching and nutrition added by LeanTrack.

ingredients.text: ½ cup chopped red bell peppers
½ cup chopped green bell peppers
8 slices cooked bacon, drained and crumbled
a couple drops of your favorite hot sauce (optional)

steps: Melt butter in a large skillet or on a griddle.
Sauté onion, bell pepper, ham and bacon in the butter until the onion starts to become translucent.
In a small bowl, whip the eggs lightly. Add salt, pepper, and hot sauce if desired.
Slowly stir the eggs into the mixture in the skillet.
Lightly brown on one side.
Flip over and lightly brown other side.

recipes.title: Eggplant and Chickpea Skillet
recipes.attribution: "Eggplant and Chickpea Skillet" by Wikibooks contributors (https://en.wikibooks.org/w/index.php?title=Cookbook%3AEggplant_and_Chickpea_Skillet&action=history), revision 4610541, CC BY-SA 4.0. Ingredient matching and nutrition added by LeanTrack.

ingredients.text: 1 small eggplant (aubergine) or 2 Italian eggplants, quartered and sliced
2–3 cups (200–250 g) broccoli, cut into small florets

steps: Sauté the green bell pepper and garlic in the oil over medium heat for several minutes. Add mushrooms and eggplant and continue cooking, stirring often, for 5 minutes.
Add the tomatoes with their juice, chickpeas and tarragon. Stir well, cover, and simmer for 10–12 minutes until eggplant has softened somewhat.
Stir in the basil leaves and broccoli and simmer, partially covered, for 8–10 minutes or until broccoli is bright green.
Season to taste with salt and freshly ground black pepper.
Serve over rice or couscous.

recipes.title: Flavorful Green Beans
recipes.summary: The seasonings are perfect companions to the green beans.
recipes.source: NHLBI (NIH), Heart Healthy Home Cooking African American Style
recipes.license: Public domain (U.S. federal government work, 17 U.S.C. § 105)
recipes.attribution: Recipe from "Heart Healthy Home Cooking African American Style", National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute, National Institutes of Health.
steps: Rinse green beans and snap off tips.
Place green beans in a large pot and add ½ cup of cold water.
Cook green beans on stovetop over medium heat for 10 minutes.
Spray a sauté pan with cooking spray, and sauté the chopped onions and garlic for 5 minutes, or until they are tender and very lightly browned.

Add onions, garlic, and black pepper to green beans. Spray the cooking spray over mixture, and cook on medium heat for another 20 minutes or until green beans are tender, but not soft. Stir occasionally.
Sprinkle dried basil and oregano over green beans. Mix and serve.

recipes.title: Fresh Lumpia (Lumpiang Sariwa)
recipes.summary: These delicious spring rolls are a traditional Filipino dish.
recipes.source: NHLBI (NIH), Healthy Heart, Healthy Family Manual for the Filipino Community
recipes.license: Public domain (U.S. federal government work, 17 U.S.C. § 105)
recipes.attribution: Recipe from "Healthy Heart, Healthy Family Manual for the Filipino Community", National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute, National Institutes of Health.

ingredients.text: ½ C ground chicken breast or lean pork
½ C shrimp, peeled and deveined
1 C broth from preparing the filling
ingredients.note: broth from cooking the filling (already counted above)

ingredients.text: 8 Vietnamese spring-roll wrappers or lumpia wrappers
⅓ C dry roasted peanuts, chopped

steps: Prepare the filling: Heat oil in a sauté pan, and sauté the ground meat with the shrimp and garlic.
Add the vegetables (cabbage, green beans, carrots, celery, and jicama), and sauté until slightly crisp.
Add the chicken broth, and continue until vegetables are cooked. Season with salt and black pepper.
Remove from heat and use a colander to strain; save the broth for use in preparing the lumpia sauce (steps below). Let meat and vegetable mixture cool to room temperature.
Meanwhile, prepare the sauce: Mix 1 cup of the broth strained from the cooked filling, soy sauce, brown sugar, and garlic together in a saucepan, and bring to a boil.
In a small bowl, mix the cornstarch in 2 tablespoons of cold water. Slowly add the cornstarch mixture to the broth in the saucepan. Stir over medium heat until sauce thickens.
To assemble the spring rolls: Soak one spring roll wrapper in warm water until soft and transparent. Dry immediately with a paper towel.
Place the wrapper on a plate, and lay a piece of lettuce on the wrapper. Put 2 tablespoons of the meat and vegetable mixture on the wrapper.
Fold bottom of wrapper over filling; wrap one side over filling and roll to the other side (to seal in the filling).
Repeat with remaining wrappers and filling.
Serve with lumpia sauce on top. Sprinkle with chopped peanuts.
tips: Jicama looks similar to a turnip or a large radish. Water chestnut can be used as an alternative.

recipes.title: Garden Potato Salad
recipes.summary: Low-fat cottage cheese is the secret to the dressing in this delicious low-fat, low-cholesterol, and low-sodium mixture of vegetables and herbs.
recipes.license: Public domain (U.S. federal government work, 17 U.S.C. § 105)
recipes.attribution: Recipe from "Stay Young At Heart", National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute, National Institutes of Health.

ingredients.text: 3 lb potatoes (about 6 large), boiled in jackets, peeled and cut into ½-inch cubes

steps: In a large bowl, place potatoes, celery, green onion, and parsley.
Meanwhile, in a blender or food processor, blend cottage cheese, milk, lemon juice, vinegar, celery seed, dill weed, dry mustard, and white pepper until smooth. Chill for 1 hour.
Pour chilled cottage cheese mixture over vegetables; mix well.
Chill for at least 30 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Grapesicles
recipes.summary: Try this snack on a hot summer day!
recipes.license: Public domain (U.S. federal government work, 17 U.S.C. § 105)
recipes.attribution: Recipe from "Deliciously Healthy Family Meals", National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute, National Institutes of Health.
steps: Thread six grapes, alternating grape colors, onto each wooden skewer.
Place skewers into the freezer for 30 minutes, or until frozen.
Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Grilled Tuna With Chickpea and Spinach Salad
recipes.summary: Tuna is a sturdy fish that is easy to grill or broil.
recipes.license: Public domain (U.S. federal government work, 17 U.S.C. § 105)
recipes.attribution: Recipe from "Deliciously Healthy Dinners", National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute, National Institutes of Health.

ingredients.text: 12 oz tuna steak, cut into 4 portions (3 oz each)
For salad: ½ can (15½ oz) low-sodium chickpeas (or garbanzo beans), drained and rinsed
½ bag (10 oz) leaf spinach, rinsed and dried
1 medium tomato, rinsed and cut into wedges

steps: Preheat grill pan or oven broiler (with the rack 3 inches from heat source) on high temperature.
Combine oil, garlic, lemon juice, and oregano, and brush over tuna steaks. Marinate for 5–10 minutes.
Meanwhile, combine all salad ingredients. (Salad can be made up to 2 hours in advance and refrigerated.)
Grill or broil tuna on high heat for 3–4 minutes on each side until the flesh is opaque and separates easily with a fork (to a minimum internal temperature of 145 °F).
Serve one tuna steak over 1 cup of mixed salad.
tips: Try with a side of quinoa seasoned with paprika and cumin.

recipes.title: Grilled Vegetable Sandwich
recipes.attribution: "Grilled Vegetable Sandwich" by Wikibooks contributors (https://en.wikibooks.org/w/index.php?title=Cookbook%3AGrilled_Vegetable_Sandwich&action=history), revision 4518254, CC BY-SA 4.0. Ingredient matching and nutrition added by LeanTrack.

ingredients.text: 2 slices of bread (preferably organic wholemeal bread)
Sliced vegetables (e.g. mushrooms, courgettes, tomatoes, peppers, etc.)
ingredients.note: amount not given in the source (not counted)

steps: Place bread slices next to each other on a baking tray.
Arrange the vegetables evenly across both slices.
Drizzle the olive oil over the vegetables, and add liberal sprinklings of oregano.
Broil on medium-high heat for 5–10 minutes, or until golden brown.
Serve open-faced, or carefully combine the two parts of the sandwich.

recipes.title: Hash Browns
recipes.attribution: "Hash Browns" by Wikibooks contributors (https://en.wikibooks.org/w/index.php?title=Cookbook%3AHash_Browns&action=history), revision 4501537, CC BY-SA 4.0. Ingredient matching and nutrition added by LeanTrack.

ingredients.text: Cooking oil (canola is good—see smoke point information)
ingredients.note: amount not given in the source (not counted)

steps: Grate the raw potatoes with a cheese grater, place them into a bowl and cover completely with water. Let sit for 10 minutes.
Drain the grated potatoes well; if this is not done thoroughly the potatoes will steam instead of fry.
Mix in chopped onions by hand.
Mix the egg OR flour into the hash brown mixture evenly. This will allow the hash browns to stay together when frying.
Place a large frying pan on medium-high heat and add enough oil to provide a thin coating over the entire bottom of the pan.

When the oil has come up to temperature apply a large handful of potatoes to the pan and reshape into a patty that is about ¼–½ inch (6–12 mm) thick. The thinner the patty, the crispier the hash browns will be throughout.
Flip when they are crisp and brown on the cooking side. They should also stick together nicely before they are flipped. This should take about 5–8 minutes.
The hash browns are done when the new side is brown and crispy. This should take another 3–5 minutes.

recipes.title: Hawaiian Huli Huli Chicken
recipes.summary: So fun to eat and healthy too!
recipes.license: Public domain (U.S. federal government work, 17 U.S.C. § 105)
recipes.attribution: Recipe from "Deliciously Healthy Family Meals", National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute, National Institutes of Health.

ingredients.text: 12 oz boneless, skinless chicken breast, cut into 1-inch cubes (24 cubes) (about 2 large breasts)
1 C fresh pineapple, diced (24 pieces) (or canned pineapple chunks in juice)

steps: Preheat a broiler or grill on medium-high heat.
Thread three chicken cubes and three pineapple chunks alternately on each skewer.
Combine ingredients for sauce and mix well; separate into two bowls and set one aside for later.
Grill skewers for 3–5 minutes on each side. Brush or spoon sauce (from the bowl that wasn’t set aside) onto chicken and pineapple about every other minute. Discard the sauce when done with this step.

To prevent chicken from drying out, finish cooking skewers in a 350 °F oven immediately after grilling (to a minimum internal temperature of 165 °F). Using a clean brush or spoon, coat with sauce from the set-aside bowl before serving.

recipes.title: Heavenly Chicken With Angel Hair Pasta
recipes.summary: A mildly spicy sauce complements this simple, but heavenly, chicken and pasta dish.
recipes.license: Public domain (U.S. federal government work, 17 U.S.C. § 105)
recipes.attribution: Recipe from "Deliciously Healthy Dinners", National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute, National Institutes of Health.

ingredients.text: 1 Tbsp garlic, minced or pressed (about 2–3 cloves)
8 oz very thinly sliced chicken breast, cut in ½-inch strips

steps: In a 4-quart saucepan, bring 3 quarts of water to a boil over high heat.
While the water heats, chop onion, mince garlic, and cut broccoli into tiny florets. Set aside.
In a large nonstick pan, heat olive oil until very hot. Add the chicken. Cook and stir until lightly browned on both sides, about 5–8 minutes. Place chicken on a clean plate, and cover to keep warm.
Coat pan with cooking spray. Over medium heat, cook and stir the onion for about 3 minutes. Add the garlic and broccoli. Cook and stir for 2 more minutes.

Return the chicken to the pan. Add entire jar of pasta sauce, cayenne pepper, and salt. Gently mix to blend ingredients. Cover. Simmer until chicken and vegetables are warmed through, about 4 minutes.
Drop pasta into boiling water. Cook according to package directions for the shortest recommended time, about 2 minutes. Drain.
Divide pasta among four dinner plates (about 1 cup each). Top each with one-fourth of the chicken and sauce mixture. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Homemade Turkey Soup
recipes.summary: Use your leftover holiday turkey to make this flavorful, from-scratch soup!
recipes.license: Public domain (U.S. federal government work, 17 U.S.C. § 105)
recipes.attribution: Recipe from "Stay Young At Heart", National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute, National Institutes of Health.

ingredients.text: 1 turkey carcass—it should have some meat (at least 2 C) remaining
½ lb Italian pastina or other small pasta

steps: Place turkey carcass in a large 6-quart pot. Cover with water, at least ¾ full.
Peel onions, cut into large pieces, and add to pot. Wash celery stalks, slice, and add to pot as well.
Simmer, covered, for about 2 ½ hours.
Remove carcass from pot. Cool soup in the refrigerator (hint: divide soup into smaller, shallower containers for quicker cooling).
While soup is cooling, remove remaining meat from turkey carcass. Discard bones and cut meat into bite-sized pieces.
After soup has cooled, skim off fat from top. Return soup to pot.
Add turkey meat to skimmed soup, along with herbs and spices.
Bring to a boil and add pastina. Continue cooking on low boil for about 20 minutes, until pastina is done. Serve at once or refrigerate for later reheating.

recipes.title: Honey-Peppered Salmon
recipes.attribution: "Honey-Peppered Salmon" by Wikibooks contributors (https://en.wikibooks.org/w/index.php?title=Cookbook%3AHoney-Peppered_Salmon&action=history), revision 4613398, CC BY-SA 4.0. Ingredient matching and nutrition added by LeanTrack.
steps: In a shallow dish, combine oil, honey, mustard, garlic, cayenne, coriander, lemon juice, and salt. Mix well.
Add salmon and let marinate at room temperature for 30 minutes.
Preheat oven to 350°F (175˚C).
Grease a baking dish.
Remove salmon from marinade and place in the prepared dish.
Bake for 10–12 minutes or until desired "doneness".

recipes.title: Indian Butter Chicken I
recipes.attribution: "Indian Butter Chicken I" by Wikibooks contributors (https://en.wikibooks.org/w/index.php?title=Cookbook%3AIndian_Butter_Chicken_I&action=history), revision 4510142, CC BY-SA 4.0. Ingredient matching and nutrition added by LeanTrack.

ingredients.text: 400–500 g of skinless, boneless chicken thighs or breasts (with the bone, this will probably be 800 g)

ingredients.note: spice blend not in USDA data (not counted)

steps: Trim and cut the chicken into small cubes. If you prefer chicken on the bone, cut long thin slices laterally into the chicken.

In a big bowl combine the tandoori powder, yogurt, lemon juice, and chicken. Massage this well with your hands so that all the chicken is evenly covered in the Tandoori powder. Cover and put aside for at least ½ an hour.
Heat a large saucepan or frying pan until evenly hot.

In the pan melt 2 tablespoons of butter until it is frothy. Add the onions and the cinnamon to the pan and fry lightly. When the onions are soft and starting to brown, stir in the crushed garlic and ginger. Then add the turmeric, chili, and coriander, and sauté over a medium heat.
Add the chicken and sauté, stirring constantly until the chicken has turned white. This doesn't take long, so make sure you don't overcook the chicken.
Mix in the tomato paste. Add the cream and heat through. After adding the cream and stirring, you may add additional tandoori masala. About 3–5 tablespoons is generally sufficient.
Cover and simmer for just over 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Kachumbari
recipes.attribution: "Kachumbari" by Wikibooks contributors (https://en.wikibooks.org/w/index.php?title=Cookbook%3AKachumbari&action=history), revision 4640040, CC BY-SA 4.0. Ingredient matching and nutrition added by LeanTrack.

ingredients.note: amount not given in the source (not counted)

steps: Gently toss together all the ingredients in a mixing bowl until well-distributed.
Allow the salad to rest for 5–10 minutes.
Taste the salad and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve fresh.

recipes.title: Langar Dal
recipes.attribution: "Langar Dal" by Wikibooks contributors (https://en.wikibooks.org/w/index.php?title=Cookbook%3ALangar_Dal&action=history), revision 4597437, CC BY-SA 4.0. Ingredient matching and nutrition added by LeanTrack.
steps: Rinse the dal three times and strain out the water.
Chop the onion into small cubes about 1 cm on each side.
Put the ghee in a pressure cooker and let it melt with the lid off.
Add the onions into the pot and sauté them for three minutes.
Add the turmeric powder to the pot and mix it well with the onions and ghee.
Add the dal, water, and salt.
Close the lid and seal the valve.
Pressure cook for 12 minutes.
Let the pressure release naturally.
Enjoy!

recipes.title: Lemon Rosemary Pork Tenderloin
recipes.attribution: "Lemon Rosemary Pork Tenderloin" by Wikibooks contributors (https://en.wikibooks.org/w/index.php?title=Cookbook%3ALemon_Rosemary_Pork_Tenderloin&action=history), revision 4510170, CC BY-SA 4.0. Ingredient matching and nutrition added by LeanTrack.
steps: Combine the chopped onion, oil, lemon juice, rosemary, thyme, lemon peel, minced garlic, salt, and pepper. Rub this mixture over tenderloins.
Let the tenderloins marinate, refrigerated, for as long as you want, or just immediately proceed with cooking.
Place the meat on a rack in a shallow roasting pan.
Bake uncovered at 400°F (205°C) or until a meat thermometer reads 160°F (70°C).
Cover with foil and let stand 10 minutes before slicing.

recipes.title: Lentil Soup
recipes.summary: There's no better way to warm up on a cold day than with this hearty, delicious soup.
recipes.source: NHLBI (NIH), Delicious Heart Healthy Latino Recipes
recipes.license: Public domain (U.S. federal government work, 17 U.S.C. § 105)
recipes.attribution: Recipe from "Delicious Heart Healthy Latino Recipes", National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute, National Institutes of Health.
steps: In a large soup pot, heat oil over medium heat. Add carrots, celery, and onion; cook and stir until the onion is tender.
Stir in garlic, oregano, basil, and pepper. Cook for 2 minutes.
Stir in lentils and tomatoes, then add the vegetable broth and water.
Cover and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for at least 1 hour or until lentils are tender.
Store leftovers in the refrigerator and reheat on the stove or in the microwave. The soup will taste better the next day!

recipes.title: Mango Shake
recipes.summary: People love the creamy sweet taste of this drink.
recipes.source: NHLBI (NIH), Delicious Heart Healthy Latino Recipes
recipes.license: Public domain (U.S. federal government work, 17 U.S.C. § 105)
recipes.attribution: Recipe from "Delicious Heart Healthy Latino Recipes", National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute, National Institutes of Health.

ingredients.text: 4 Tbsp frozen mango juice (or 1 fresh pitted mango)

steps: Put all ingredients into a blender. Blend until foamy. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Marinated Chicken (Adobong Manok)
recipes.summary: A heart healthy spin on a favorite Filipino dish, slowly simmered and richly flavored.
recipes.source: NHLBI (NIH), Healthy Heart, Healthy Family Manual for the Filipino Community
recipes.license: Public domain (U.S. federal government work, 17 U.S.C. § 105)
recipes.attribution: Recipe from "Healthy Heart, Healthy Family Manual for the Filipino Community", National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute, National Institutes of Health.
steps: Combine olive oil, garlic, and chopped onion in a frying pan. Add chicken, and sauté together until chicken has browned.
Add soy sauce, vinegar, paprika, black pepper, and bay leaf, and stir to mix.
Bring to a boil. Simmer for 45 to 60 minutes, or until chicken is done.
Remove the chicken, and save the liquid in the pan. Arrange the chicken on a broiler pan. Broil until the chicken has nicely browned. Remove from the broiler, and place chicken in a serving bowl.
Boil the sauce in the uncovered pan until its volume is reduced to about half and the sauce is thick.
Pour the thickened sauce over the broiled adobo (chicken), and garnish with red tomato wedges, if desired.

recipes.title: Meatloaf I
recipes.attribution: "Meatloaf I" by Wikibooks contributors (https://en.wikibooks.org/w/index.php?title=Cookbook%3AMeatloaf_I&action=history), revision 4530181, CC BY-SA 4.0. Ingredient matching and nutrition added by LeanTrack.
steps: Combine the ground beef, eggs, minced garlic, salt, allspice, curry powder, and Worcestershire sauce.
Mix in the chopped onion, celery, and cracker crumbs.
Press the mixture into a standard loaf pan.
Bake at 400°F (200°C) for about 10–20 minutes until browned on top.
Tilt the pan, and drain off any accumulated grease. Add the mushroom soup on top.
Bake another 1.5–2 hours until cooked through.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Beef Stew
recipes.attribution: "Mediterranean Beef Stew" by Wikibooks contributors (https://en.wikibooks.org/w/index.php?title=Cookbook%3AMediterranean_Beef_Stew&action=history), revision 4524813, CC BY-SA 4.0. Ingredient matching and nutrition added by LeanTrack.

ingredients.text: 500 g (1.1 lb) of lean beef stewing/braising steak (in steaks, not diced)
600 g (1.3 lb) of green olives, stones removed
1 large clove of garlic, finely chopped

ingredients.note: amount not given in the source (not counted)

steps: In a large saucepan or casserole dish, gently fry the onion and garlic in plenty of good olive oil for a few minutes, taking care not to brown them.
Season the beef well with salt and black pepper and immediately add to the pan. Fry until evenly sealed and lightly browned.
Add the olives and tomatoes to the pan and simmer gently for two hours with the lid on.
Serve.

recipes.title: Minestrone Soup
recipes.summary: A cholesterol-free version of this classic Italian vegetable soup — brimming with fiber-rich beans, peas, and carrots.
recipes.license: Public domain (U.S. federal government work, 17 U.S.C. § 105)
recipes.attribution: Recipe from "Stay Young At Heart", National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute, National Institutes of Health.

ingredients.text: 1 clove garlic, minced, or ⅛ tsp garlic powder
1½ C coarsely chopped celery and leaves
1 C sliced carrots, fresh or frozen
1 can (1 lb) no-salt-added tomatoes, cut up
1 can (15½ oz) low-sodium red kidney beans, drained and rinsed

steps: Heat oil in a 4-quart saucepan.
Add garlic, onion, and celery and sauté about 5 minutes.
Add all remaining ingredients except spaghetti, and stir until ingredients are well mixed.
Bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer about 45 minutes or until vegetables are tender.
Add uncooked spaghetti and simmer 2-3 minutes only. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Mushroom Penne
recipes.summary: A mushroom lover’s dish that makes a quick and cozy meal at home or an elegant dish for company.
recipes.license: Public domain (U.S. federal government work, 17 U.S.C. § 105)
recipes.attribution: Recipe from "Deliciously Healthy Dinners", National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute, National Institutes of Health.

ingredients.text: 8 oz white mushrooms, rinsed and sliced
1 Tbsp garlic, minced or pressed (about 2–3 cloves)

steps: In a 4-quart saucepan, bring 3 quarts of water to a boil over high heat.
While water heats and pasta cooks, warm olive oil in a large nonstick pan over medium heat.
Add pasta, and cook according to package directions for the shortest recommended time, about 8 minutes.
Chop the mushrooms into bite-sized pieces. Cook the mushrooms in the oil for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, slice onion and mince garlic. Add to mushrooms. Cook for 3 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add wine. Cook and stir to loosen any flavorful browned bits to mix into the sauce. Stir in chicken broth, salt, pepper, and thyme.
Drain pasta. Stir into mushroom mixture. Continue simmering mixture until all moisture is absorbed, about 3 minutes.
Divide into four equal portions (each about 1¼ cups). Top each with 1 tablespoon shredded parmesan cheese.

recipes.title: Mushroom Soup
recipes.attribution: "Mushroom Soup" by Wikibooks contributors (https://en.wikibooks.org/w/index.php?title=Cookbook%3AMushroom_Soup&action=history), revision 4610476, CC BY-SA 4.0. Ingredient matching and nutrition added by LeanTrack.

ingredients.text: 4 cups button mushrooms, sliced if large

steps: In a large pot over medium heat, melt one stick of the butter.
Add ½ cup of the flour, stirring constantly, to form a roux.
Cook, continuing to stir constantly, until roux takes on a pale blond color, about 5 minutes.
Slowly stir in the beef stock.
Bring to a boil, stirring frequently.
Reduce heat to a simmer.
In a large saucepan over medium-high heat, melt the remaining stick of butter with the olive oil.
Add the portobellos, shiitakes, and button mushrooms and sauté until mushrooms are moist and tender, 5–10 minutes.
Remove pan from heat and dust mushrooms with the remaining ½ cup of flour, tossing gently to incorporate flour.
Combine mushrooms and beef stock in the large pot.
Stir in the sherry.
Cook, stirring occasionally, until flavors are melded and soup thickened slightly, about 10 minutes.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: New Orleans Red Beans
recipes.summary: Enjoy this cholesterol-free and virtually fat-free take on a very tasty New Orleans tradition!
recipes.license: Public domain (U.S. federal government work, 17 U.S.C. § 105)
recipes.attribution: Recipe from "Stay Young At Heart", National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute, National Institutes of Health.
steps: Pick through beans to remove bad beans; rinse thoroughly.

In a large pot combine the beans, water, onion, celery, and bay leaves. Bring to a boil; reduce heat. Cover and cook over low heat for about 1½ hours or until beans are tender. Stir. Use a spoon to mash the beans against the side of the pot.
Add green pepper, garlic, parsley, thyme, salt, and black pepper. Cook, uncovered, over low heat until creamy, about 30 minutes. Remove bay leaves.
Serve with hot cooked brown rice, if desired.

recipes.title: Oat Porridge
recipes.attribution: "Oat Porridge" by Wikibooks contributors (https://en.wikibooks.org/w/index.php?title=Cookbook%3AOat_Porridge&action=history), revision 4606890, CC BY-SA 4.0. Ingredient matching and nutrition added by LeanTrack.

ingredients.text: ½ cup (45 g) rolled oats or other grain

steps: Mix oats and water, then bring to the boil, covered with a lid.
Once bubbling, stir and reduce temperature to the lowest possible to maintain simmering. Replace lid and watch carefully to prevent boiling over.
Stir every minute or so. After five minutes, remove lid, stir thoroughly and add milk.
Mix through, and keep stirring until fully mixed.
Serve and add raisins, sugar, brown sugar, maple syrup, a pinch of salt, honey or inverted sugar syrup to taste.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Cookies I
recipes.attribution: "Oatmeal Cookies I" by Wikibooks contributors (https://en.wikibooks.org/w/index.php?title=Cookbook%3AOatmeal_Cookies_I&action=history), revision 4587304, CC BY-SA 4.0. Ingredient matching and nutrition added by LeanTrack.
steps: Using a mixer, cream together the shortening, brown sugar, white sugar, egg, water and vanilla until light and fluffy (about 10 minutes on high).
In a mixing bowl, mix together the oats, flour, baking soda, and salt.
Add dry ingredients into wet, mix well using mixer.
Stir in raisins if using.
Scoop the portions out—this recipe makes 20 cookies, so make 20 portions.
Bake at 350°F (180°C) for 8–10 minutes.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Muffins
recipes.attribution: "Oatmeal Muffins" by Wikibooks contributors (https://en.wikibooks.org/w/index.php?title=Cookbook%3AOatmeal_Muffins&action=history), revision 4524799, CC BY-SA 4.0. Ingredient matching and nutrition added by LeanTrack.
steps: Stir rolled oats and buttermilk together in a mixing bowl.
Combine flour, coconut, brown sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt in another mixing bowl. Stir together to mix. Make a well in the center.
Add egg and margarine to oat mixture. Mix well.
Pour all at once into flour mixture. Stir just to moisten.
Fill muffin cups ¾ full.
Bake at 400°F (200°C) for 15–20 minutes.

recipes.title: Original Texas-Style Chili
recipes.attribution: "Original Texas-Style Chili" by Wikibooks contributors (https://en.wikibooks.org/w/index.php?title=Cookbook%3AOriginal_Texas-Style_Chili&action=history), revision 4518786, CC BY-SA 4.0. Ingredient matching and nutrition added by LeanTrack.

ingredients.text: 4 chile pods, skinned and blistered, or sun-dried chiles
1 tablespoon Tabasco sauce (optional but frequently included)
2 garlic cloves, chopped (or more, to taste)

steps: Sear beef in a little cooking oil (not lard) until lightly browned.

Add the seared beef, suet, and chile pods to a large iron skillet or pot (at least four quarts), and enough water (the reserved "pepper water" if you prepared the pods yourself) to keep the meat from burning. Bring to a boil, then lower heat, cover, and simmer about 30 minutes.

Take pot off the stove and add spices and garlic. Put back on the stove, bring to a boil again, lower heat, and simmer another hour, keeping the lid on as much as possible. Stir when necessary, but remember that too much stirring will tear the meat. Add a little more water if anything seems seriously in danger of burning (but as little water as possible).
Take pot off the stove and skim off all or most of the grease.

Mix in masa harina, which "tightens" or thickens the chili con carne and adds a subtle tamale-like flavor. Simmer about 30 minutes more, until meat is done. Do a lot of tasting during this time, (1) to adjust the seasoning, and (2) just because a chili cook should do a lot of tasting.

recipes.title: Oven-Fried Yucca
recipes.summary: Crispy and delicious! Use cooking spray to cut back on fat.
recipes.source: NHLBI (NIH), Delicious Heart Healthy Latino Recipes
recipes.license: Public domain (U.S. federal government work, 17 U.S.C. § 105)
recipes.attribution: Recipe from "Delicious Heart Healthy Latino Recipes", National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute, National Institutes of Health.

ingredients.text: 1 pound fresh yucca (cassava), cut into 3-inch sections and peeled (or 1 pound peeled frozen yucca)

steps: In a kettle, combine the yucca with enough cold water to cover it by 1 inch. Bring the water to a boil, and slowly simmer the yucca for 20 to 30 minutes, or until it is tender.
Preheat oven to 350° F.
Transfer the yucca with a slotted spoon to a cutting board, let it cool, and cut it lengthwise into ¾-inch-wide wedges, discarding the thin woody core.

Spray a cookie sheet lightly with the cooking spray. Spread yucca wedges in a single layer on the cookie sheet, and spray the wedges with cooking spray. Cover with foil and bake for 8 minutes. Uncover and return to oven to bake for an additional 7 minutes.

recipes.title: Pancakes (North American)
recipes.attribution: "Pancakes (North American)" by Wikibooks contributors (https://en.wikibooks.org/w/index.php?title=Cookbook%3APancakes_(North_American)&action=history), revision 4671208, CC BY-SA 4.0. Ingredient matching and nutrition added by LeanTrack.

ingredients.text: 120 g (1 cup or 8 oz) wheat flour (white, whole grain or 1:1 mix of white and whole grain)
250 ml (1 cup or 8 fl oz) milk (substitute buttermilk or 1:1 mix of milk and buttermilk)

1 tbsp white sugar (optional; this will add a sweetness to your pancakes and is recommended if you are not using any sauces, syrups or ingredient such as bananas or blueberries that will add natural sugars to the mix)

steps: In a large bowl, mix dry ingredients together until well-blended.
Add milk and mix well until smooth.
Separate the egg, placing the whites in a medium bowl and the yolks in the batter. Mix batter well.
Whip whites until stiff and then fold into batter gently (skip this step for heavier pancakes or if 1 cup buttermilk is substituted for milk).
Pour ladles of the mixture into a non-stick pan, one at a time.
Cook until the edges are dry and bubbles appear on surface. Flip, then cook until golden.

recipes.title: Party Mix
recipes.attribution: "Party Mix" by Wikibooks contributors (https://en.wikibooks.org/w/index.php?title=Cookbook%3AParty_Mix&action=history), revision 4502850, CC BY-SA 4.0. Ingredient matching and nutrition added by LeanTrack.

ingredients.text: 1 cup (120g) garlic-flavor bite-size bagel chips or regular-size bagel chips, broken into 1-inch pieces

steps: Heat oven to 250°F (120°C).
In an ungreased large roasting pan, melt butter in oven.
Stir in seasonings.
Gradually stir in remaining ingredients until evenly coated.
Bake for 1 hour, stirring every 15 minutes.
Spread on paper towels to cool, about 15 minutes.
Store in airtight container.
In large microwavable bowl, microwave butter uncovered on high about 40 seconds or until melted.
Stir in seasonings.
Gradually stir in remaining ingredients until evenly coated.
Microwave uncovered on high 5–6 minutes, thoroughly stirring every 2 minutes.
Spread on paper towels to cool.
Store in airtight container.

recipes.title: Pasta with Vegetables
recipes.attribution: "Pasta with Vegetables" by Wikibooks contributors (https://en.wikibooks.org/w/index.php?title=Cookbook%3APasta_with_Vegetables&action=history), revision 4493953, CC BY-SA 4.0. Ingredient matching and nutrition added by LeanTrack.
steps: Bring 2 liters water to a boil with the salt.
Add spaghetti to boiling water. Cook for 4 minutes.
Add chopped tomatoes and cucumber to the boiling pasta. Boil for another 5 minutes.
Drain the water, add the butter or oil, and mix in the chopped onion.
Mix in sauce or ketchup, and serve.

recipes.title: Peach and Tomato Gazpacho
recipes.attribution: "Peach and Tomato Gazpacho" by Wikibooks contributors (https://en.wikibooks.org/w/index.php?title=Cookbook%3APeach_and_Tomato_Gazpacho&action=history), revision 4525008, CC BY-SA 4.0. Ingredient matching and nutrition added by LeanTrack.

ingredients.text: 2 cups (473 ml / 1 lb / 454 g) pitted peaches
1 Tbsp (15 ml / 8 sprigs) chopped fresh tarragon

steps: Cut the tomato into sections, place ⅔ into the blender, and set the other ⅓ to the side in the small bowl.
Run the blender on high speed to purée the tomatoes.
Cut the pitted peaches into sections, place ½ into the blender, and set the other ½ to the side in the small bowl.
Add the peaches to the tomato purée and blend on high speed to purée the peaches.
Cut the shallot into sections, place into the mixture, and purée.
Chop the fresh tarragon, removing and discarding any large stems, place the leaves into the blender mixture, and purée.
Add olive oil, white wine vinegar, tarragon, salt, and pepper to blender and mix well.
Add crushed ice into the blender and purée for 30 seconds on highest power.
Add contents from small bowl into blender and pulse on lowest setting very briefly (this will provide some texture to gazpacho with small chunks of tomato and peach).
Serve right away as chilled gazpacho soup.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Banana Oatmeal
recipes.attribution: "Peanut Butter Banana Oatmeal" by Wikibooks contributors (https://en.wikibooks.org/w/index.php?title=Cookbook%3APeanut_Butter_Banana_Oatmeal&action=history), revision 4522503, CC BY-SA 4.0. Ingredient matching and nutrition added by LeanTrack.

ingredients.text: 1 cup rolled oats or instant oats
½ tbsp (or more) honey, to taste

steps: Cook the oats in water. If using regular oats this should take around 10 minutes, while instant oats will cook more quickly.
Put the cooked oats in a bowl
Add milk, peanut butter, honey and sliced banana.
Mash until the banana and ingredients are all thoroughly combined.
Top with honey and serve warm.

recipes.title: Peanut Chicken Stir-Fry
recipes.attribution: "Peanut Chicken Stir-Fry" by Wikibooks contributors (https://en.wikibooks.org/w/index.php?title=Cookbook%3APeanut_Chicken_Stir-Fry&action=history), revision 4513031, CC BY-SA 4.0. Ingredient matching and nutrition added by LeanTrack.

ingredients.note: amount not given in the source (not counted)

steps: Melt butter in wok or skillet.
Stir-fry celery and onions.
Add chicken and mushrooms and stir over lowered heat 5 minutes.
Combine (in separate bowl) cornstarch, soy sauce, and broth; slowly add to hot mixture in wok and cook 5 minutes.
Stir in peanuts.
Serve over hot rice.

recipes.title: Pear and Almond Smoothie (Vegan)
recipes.attribution: "Pear and Almond Smoothie (Vegan)" by Wikibooks contributors (https://en.wikibooks.org/w/index.php?title=Cookbook%3APear_and_Almond_Smoothie_(Vegan)&action=history), revision 4512360, CC BY-SA 4.0. Ingredient matching and nutrition added by LeanTrack.
steps: Cut the pear into chunks, discarding the core. Place the chunks of pear in a blender.
Squeeze the juice of the lemon over the pear.
Add the almond milk. Blend. Serve immediately

recipes.title: Pinto Beans
recipes.summary: A heart-healthy take on a staple dish.
recipes.source: NHLBI (NIH), Honoring the Gift of Heart Health Manual for American Indians and Native Alaskans
recipes.license: Public domain (U.S. federal government work, 17 U.S.C. § 105)
recipes.attribution: Recipe from "Honoring the Gift of Heart Health Manual for American Indians and Native Alaskans", National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute, National Institutes of Health.
steps: Cook the dried beans as directed on the package, until they are soft. Set aside.
Spray a large saucepan with nonstick cooking spray, and preheat over medium heat. Cook celery, onion, and green pepper until soft, about 5 minutes.
Add tomatoes, water, and seasonings to vegetable mixture. Bring to a boil. Add beans, and return to a boil.
Cover and cook over low heat until flavors are blended and liquid is absorbed away, about 15 minutes. Stir once in a while to prevent from sticking.
Serve with rice that is cooked without salt.
tips: Using dried beans instead of canned beans, and fresh instead of canned tomatoes, reduces the sodium. The recipe also uses fresh peppers, garlic, and onions to add flavor, rather than onion or garlic salt (another way to cut sodium content). Remember these tips to make other dishes lower in salt and sodium.

recipes.title: Pita Pizzas
recipes.summary: Personal pita pizzas are fun to make, and even more fun to eat!
recipes.license: Public domain (U.S. federal government work, 17 U.S.C. § 105)
recipes.attribution: Recipe from "Deliciously Healthy Family Meals", National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute, National Institutes of Health.

ingredients.text: 1 C grilled boneless, skinless chicken breast, diced (about 2 small breasts)
1 C broccoli, rinsed, chopped, and cooked
1 Tbsp fresh basil, rinsed, dried, and chopped (or 1 tsp dried)

steps: Preheat oven or toaster oven to 450 °F.
For each pizza, spread ¼ cup tomato sauce on a pita and top with ¼ cup chicken, ¼ cup broccoli, ½ tablespoon parmesan cheese, and ¼ tablespoon chopped basil.
Place pitas on a nonstick baking sheet and bake for about 5–8 minutes until golden brown and chicken is heated through. Serve immediately.
tips: Keep ingredients on hand for older children to make pita pizzas for themselves. Younger children can help top their own personal pizzas.

recipes.title: Portable Eggs Benedict
recipes.attribution: "Portable Eggs Benedict" by Wikibooks contributors (https://en.wikibooks.org/w/index.php?title=Cookbook%3APortable_Eggs_Benedict&action=history), revision 4514769, CC BY-SA 4.0. Ingredient matching and nutrition added by LeanTrack.

ingredients.note: amount not given in the source (not counted)

steps: Boil enough water to fill a deep pan.
Add vinegar to the water.
Crack eggs into the boiling water/vinegar mixture. Leave them alone for 5–7 minutes.
Cut open the top of a pita. Line the inside of the pita with cream cheese and smoked salmon.
Take eggs out of the pan using a slotted spoon and drop them into the pita.
Eat immediately.

recipes.title: Potato Omelet
recipes.attribution: "Potato Omelet" by Wikibooks contributors (https://en.wikibooks.org/w/index.php?title=Cookbook%3APotato_Omelet&action=history), revision 4522451, CC BY-SA 4.0. Ingredient matching and nutrition added by LeanTrack.

ingredients.text: 1 potato, cut into ¼–½-inch (~1 cm) cubes

steps: In a bowl beat together eggs, sugar, salt and pepper. Mix in milk.
Heat up two frying pans to a medium temperature.
Use butter, margarine, or cooking spray to grease each pan.
