Add chopped potatoes to one pan.
Cook potatoes until light brown, then add onions.
Add half of egg mixture to the other pan.
Cook omelet mixture until it starts to set (about 1 minute).
Add onions, potatoes, and cheese on top of partially set omelet.
Fold plain side of omelet over the filling and cook for an additional 30 seconds.

recipes.title: Potato-Chickpea Curry
recipes.attribution: "Potato-Chickpea Curry" by Wikibooks contributors (https://en.wikibooks.org/w/index.php?title=Cookbook%3APotato-Chickpea_Curry&action=history), revision 4518673, CC BY-SA 4.0. Ingredient matching and nutrition added by LeanTrack.

ingredients.note: amount not given in the source (not counted)

ingredients.text: 3 potatoes, chopped (Yukon gold are good, but use whatever you like)

steps: Chop the onion and mince the garlic. Sauté them in olive oil in a saucepan for approximately 5 minutes.
Add the curry powder and fry for a couple minutes more.
Add the coconut milk and the potatoes. Simmer, covered, for about 20 minutes.
Drain the chickpeas, add them to the pot, and simmer for about 20 minutes more, or until the potatoes are cooked.
Serve with basmati rice or whatever you prefer.

recipes.title: Rainbow Fruit Salad
recipes.summary: Makes a great side dish or dessert!
recipes.license: Public domain (U.S. federal government work, 17 U.S.C. § 105)
recipes.attribution: Recipe from "Stay Young At Heart", National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute, National Institutes of Health.

ingredients.text: For salad: 1 large mango, peeled and diced
For honey orange sauce: ⅓ C unsweetened orange juice

steps: Mix the fruit together in a large bowl.
In a small bowl, combine all the ingredients for the honey orange sauce and mix well.
Just before serving, pour the honey orange sauce over the fruit.

recipes.title: Ratatouille II
recipes.attribution: "Ratatouille II" by Wikibooks contributors (https://en.wikibooks.org/w/index.php?title=Cookbook%3ARatatouille_II&action=history), revision 4514080, CC BY-SA 4.0. Ingredient matching and nutrition added by LeanTrack.
steps: Put a pan on the stove on medium heat.
Gently fry the onion and garlic in a little oil—5 minutes should be enough to start to make them soft.
Add the peppers and courgette and continue to fry gently for a further 4–5 minutes until the ingredients soften.
Add the beans and warm through.
Serve in a bowl on its own or with toast.

recipes.title: Red Beans and Rice
recipes.summary: This quick and easy classic Cajun dish is great for a weeknight meal at home, or fun to serve at a party.
recipes.license: Public domain (U.S. federal government work, 17 U.S.C. § 105)
recipes.attribution: Recipe from "Deliciously Healthy Dinners", National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute, National Institutes of Health.

ingredients.text: 1 C onion, cut into ½-inch pieces
1 C green bell pepper, rinsed and diced
1 Tbsp garlic, minced or pressed (about 2–3 cloves)
1 can (14½ oz) low-sodium chicken broth or vegetable broth
½ C instant brown rice, uncooked
2 cans (15 oz each) low-sodium red kidney beans, drained and rinsed

steps: Heat oil in a 12-inch sauté pan over medium heat. Cook onion, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes, until pieces begin to soften, but not brown.

Meanwhile, dice green pepper into pieces about ¼ inch in size. Tip: Slice pepper lengthwise into ¼-inch strips. Holding the strips together, cut crosswise in ¼-inch pieces. Add green pepper to cooking onion. Cover. Cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
While the green pepper and onion cook, mince the garlic. Add garlic, cumin, and oregano to the sauté pan. Cook and stir for 1 minute.
Add broth and rice to sauté pan with green pepper and onion. Stir well, cover, and simmer for 10 minutes.
Meanwhile, drain beans and rinse thoroughly.
Add beans to sauté pan. Stir well. Cover. Simmer for 5 minutes to heat beans and blend flavors.

recipes.title: Red Lentil Soup
recipes.attribution: "Red Lentil Soup" by Wikibooks contributors (https://en.wikibooks.org/w/index.php?title=Cookbook%3ARed_Lentil_Soup&action=history), revision 4518501, CC BY-SA 4.0. Ingredient matching and nutrition added by LeanTrack.
steps: thumb|Finished lentil soup, with potatoes, parsley, and dill added|308x308pxPick over the lentils to remove any debris if needed. Rinse well.
Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. Once oil is hot, add the onion and carrots. Sauté for a few minutes, until the vegetables have started to soften, then add the garlic.
Add the lentils, bay leaf, and water to the pot. Simmer over low-medium heat for 20–30 minutes until lentils are softened.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Rice with Black Beans (Arroz con Frijoles Negros)
recipes.attribution: "Rice with Black Beans (Arroz con Frijoles Negros)" by Wikibooks contributors (https://en.wikibooks.org/w/index.php?title=Cookbook%3ARice_with_Black_Beans_(Arroz_con_Frijoles_Negros)&action=history), revision 4525536, CC BY-SA 4.0. Ingredient matching and nutrition added by LeanTrack.

ingredients.text: 1 large green pepper, cut in half with seeds and stem removed
4 cloves of garlic, smashed and chopped
1 large green pepper, seeds and stem removed, then chopped
2 tbsp sugar (or ½ packet of low-calorie sweetener)
2 tbsp dry white wine (cooking wine or dry sherry is fine)

ingredients.note: amount not given in the source (not counted)

steps: The night before you plan to cook, wash the beans and soak them in a large pot with 10 cups of water and one half of a green pepper.
The next day, cook them in the same water until they are softer (a low boil, stirring occasionally, about an hour).
In a frying pan, heat two tablespoons of oil and sauté the chopped onion, garlic, and green pepper (this is called a sofrito) until soft (about 5–10 minutes).

Take a cup of the soft black beans in some liquid and put in a blender. Liquefy the beans. Add this to the frying pan and mix the bean liquid with the sofrito. Then, add the contents of the frying pan to the big pot of beans. Add salt, pepper, oregano, bay leaf, and sugar.
Boil about another hour, stirring occasionally. Add vinegar and cooking wine.
Boil for about another hour to thicken. Add the 2 tablespoons olive oil and serve.
In another large sauce pan, combine rice, 4½ cups water, and 2 tablespoons olive oil.
Bring to a boil then reduce to simmer for about 20 minutes.
Fluff the rice with a fork once the water has evaporated.

recipes.title: Roasted Beets with Orange Sauce
recipes.summary: This colorful side dish comes alive with orange flavor.
recipes.license: Public domain (U.S. federal government work, 17 U.S.C. § 105)
recipes.attribution: Recipe from "Deliciously Healthy Dinners", National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute, National Institutes of Health.

ingredients.text: 1½ lb small beets, leaves trimmed, each peeled and cut into four chunks

steps: Preheat oven to 450 °F. Cover a baking sheet with aluminum foil for easy cleanup.
In a medium bowl, toss the beets with the olive oil until well coated.
Spread beets on baking sheet in a single layer.
Bake 30–40 minutes. When done, beets should be easily pierced with a sharp knife.

While beets bake, grate the zest from the orange. Place in a small bowl. Cut the orange in half. Squeeze the juice (about ½ cup) into the bowl with the orange zest. (Use a large spoon to press the inside of the orange to extract more juice.) Add anise seeds (optional). Set aside.
When the beets are tender, return them to the tossing bowl. Pour the juice mixture over the beets. Mix well to coat, and serve.

recipes.title: Roasted Spiced Chicken Drumsticks
recipes.attribution: "Roasted Spiced Chicken Drumsticks" by Wikibooks contributors (https://en.wikibooks.org/w/index.php?title=Cookbook%3ARoasted_Spiced_Chicken_Drumsticks&action=history), revision 4505876, CC BY-SA 4.0. Ingredient matching and nutrition added by LeanTrack.
steps: Combine the paprika, onion powder, chili powder, and salt together in a bowl.
Preheat oven to 400°F.
Pat the chicken dry with paper towels.
Coat the chicken with oil and the prepared spice blend, ensuring all sides are well-coated. Transfer to a baking dish.
Bake the chicken drumsticks until the skin is brown and crispy (about 25 minutes).
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Rosemary Grilled Salmon Steaks
recipes.attribution: "Rosemary Grilled Salmon Steaks" by Wikibooks contributors (https://en.wikibooks.org/w/index.php?title=Cookbook%3ARosemary_Grilled_Salmon_Steaks&action=history), revision 4508858, CC BY-SA 4.0. Ingredient matching and nutrition added by LeanTrack.
steps: Combine the oil, vinegar, rosemary, and pepper. Add salmon steaks, and marinate for 15 minutes.
Place the steaks on a hot grill, cooking on each side for 3 minutes until flaky.

recipes.title: Salmon with Rice and Sauce
recipes.attribution: "Salmon with Rice and Sauce" by Wikibooks contributors (https://en.wikibooks.org/w/index.php?title=Cookbook%3ASalmon_with_Rice_and_Sauce&action=history), revision 4494430, CC BY-SA 4.0. Ingredient matching and nutrition added by LeanTrack.

ingredients.text: 250 g Atlantic salmon fillet (fresh or thawed)

steps: If using frozen salmon, put the plastic-packaged fillets in the sink or a larger pot. Fill up the sink or pot with 40°C water so that the plastic salmon package floats. Let soak until thawed.
Prepare the oven and set it to 170°C with heat source top and bottom.
Place uncooked rice in stock pot.
Fill the pot with cold water so the rice gets covered.
Pour water and rice from pot into a sieve or colander. Let the strainer stay inside the sink. It is okay if some rice stays behind in the pot after all the water has drained.
Transfer drained rice from strainer back into the stock pot using a large spoon. All remaining rice should end up in the pot.
Add the water to the pot with the rice, stirring to combine. Make sure that all rice is in the water, and put on the pot lid.
Put pot on stove over the highest heat. Check the rice regularly, and when the rice starts boiling reduce the heat to low. It should at most be at a low simmer.
Cook for 20 minutes, until the water is absorbed and the rice is cooked.
Place the carrots on the cutting board.
Place kitchen knife and peeler on cutting board.
Rinse the carrots under cold water.
Peel the carrots.
Cut the carrots in 4 equal in length pieces, and cut each one in the middle.
Put carrots in an empty soup plate for salad.
Put the frozen peas in a plate or soup bowl and thaw them in the strainer. Pour water on them so they will thaw quickly. Even just using cold water will still thaw them.
Once the salmon has fully thawed, open the container and drain off of any liquids it contains.
Put the salmon in a cake pan.
Wash your hands to remove the smell of salmon, and discard the salmon packaging.
Put the crème fraîche in a bowl using a spoon, then let spoon stay in bowl.
Add the hot sauce to the crème fraîche. Mix with spoon to make a mostly homogeneous sauce.
Pour the sauce over the salmon in the cake tin, so the sauce fully covers the salmon.
Put cake tin in preheated oven, and bake for 15 minutes.
Serve the cooked salmon with the rice and prepared salad.

recipes.title: Sausage-Egg Breakfast Dish
recipes.attribution: "Sausage-Egg Breakfast Dish" by Wikibooks contributors (https://en.wikibooks.org/w/index.php?title=Cookbook%3ASausage-Egg_Breakfast_Dish&action=history), revision 4525172, CC BY-SA 4.0. Ingredient matching and nutrition added by LeanTrack.
steps: Brown sausage and sprinkle with pepper.
Drain off excess fat, and let sausage cool.
Beat eggs and add milk.
Fold in cubes of stale bread, cheese, and cooled sausage.
Pour into and 8 by 8-inch baking dish coated with cooking spray.
Refrigerate for at least an hour (or freeze for later).
Preheat oven to 325°F. Bake for 1 hour.
Cool and cut into squares.

recipes.title: Savory Potato Salad
recipes.summary: Here’s a potato salad that’s both traditional and new — with great taste and a low-fat twist.
recipes.source: NHLBI (NIH), Heart Healthy Home Cooking African American Style
recipes.license: Public domain (U.S. federal government work, 17 U.S.C. § 105)
recipes.attribution: Recipe from "Heart Healthy Home Cooking African American Style", National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute, National Institutes of Health.

ingredients.text: ¼ C red bell pepper, coarsely chopped
¼ C green bell pepper, coarsely chopped

steps: Wash potatoes, cut in half, and place in saucepan of cold water. Cook, covered, over medium heat for 25 to 30 minutes or until tender.
Drain and dice potatoes when cool.
Add vegetables and egg to potatoes, and toss.
In a small bowl, blend together the mayonnaise, mustard, salt, pepper, and dill weed.
Pour dressing over potato mixture and stir gently to coat evenly.
Chill for at least 1 hour before serving.

recipes.title: Scottish Porridge
recipes.attribution: "Scottish Porridge" by Wikibooks contributors (https://en.wikibooks.org/w/index.php?title=Cookbook%3AScottish_Porridge&action=history), revision 4654622, CC BY-SA 4.0. Ingredient matching and nutrition added by LeanTrack.

ingredients.text: ½ cup (80 g) steel-cut oats, also called Irish oats
1 teaspoon lemon juice or apple cider vinegar (for soaking)
1 teaspoon of buckwheat flour (for reducing phytates)

steps: Mix the steel-cut oats with a teaspoon of buckwheat flour in a bowl.
Add warm water to soak the oats and add a splash of lemon juice or apple cider vinegar. Cover and allow to soak overnight or at least 7 to 8 hours.
Place the oats, salt and water into a small pan and gently bring it to a small boil, stirring occasionally until the porridge starts to thicken.

Once the thickening has begun, lower the heat to low to avoid burning the porridge and allow it to simmer for approximately 15 to 20 minutes (or less if the oats are tender and reached your preferred consistency).
Remove from the heat and let it stand for 1 or 2 minutes before serving.
Serve and top with your choice of toppings, such as chia seeds, walnuts, tablespoon of peanut butter, berries, cinnamon, or a dollop of Greek yogurt.

recipes.title: Scrambled Eggs with Vegetables
recipes.attribution: "Scrambled Eggs with Vegetables" by Wikibooks contributors (https://en.wikibooks.org/w/index.php?title=Cookbook%3AScrambled_Eggs_with_Vegetables&action=history), revision 4493922, CC BY-SA 4.0. Ingredient matching and nutrition added by LeanTrack.

ingredients.note: amount not given in the source (not counted)

steps: Heat a frying pan over medium heat, and add oil.
Add tomato and cucumber to the pan. Cook for 2 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add salt.
Beat the eggs with the onion and additional salt if desired. Transfer mixture to the pan.
Cook eggs and vegetables, turning every 30 seconds until cooked to taste.
Serve.

recipes.title: Shepherd's Pie II
recipes.attribution: "Shepherd's Pie II" by Wikibooks contributors (https://en.wikibooks.org/w/index.php?title=Cookbook%3AShepherd's_Pie_II&action=history), revision 4537924, CC BY-SA 4.0. Ingredient matching and nutrition added by LeanTrack.

ingredients.text: 1 pound (450 g) lean ground hamburger meat
12 oz (341 ml or 1 can) creamed corn
Salt, pepper, and butter to taste
1–2 cups shredded Cheddar or Mexican blend cheese (optional, amount depends on how much cheese you want)

steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C)
In a large skillet, brown the hamburger meat until it is no longer pink
In a medium baking pan, evenly layer the meat on the bottom, then corn. Spread a layer of potatoes.
If using, sprinkle cheese on top.
Bake in the oven for about 30 minutes, or until the cheese is melted.

recipes.title: Smoked Salmon Breakfast Burrito
recipes.attribution: "Smoked Salmon Breakfast Burrito" by Wikibooks contributors (https://en.wikibooks.org/w/index.php?title=Cookbook%3ASmoked_Salmon_Breakfast_Burrito&action=history), revision 4523410, CC BY-SA 4.0. Ingredient matching and nutrition added by LeanTrack.

ingredients.text: ¼ cup smoked salmon cream cheese spread

steps: In a small bowl, whisk together eggs, milk, lemon juice, and pepper.
In sauté pan over medium heat, add oil to coat the pan, add egg mixture to scramble.
Toast the tortillas in a cast iron skillet over medium heat. Spread cream spread in a circle with 2 inches from the edge of tortilla. Add eggs.
Wrap and enjoy.

recipes.title: Southwestern Black Beans and Rice
recipes.attribution: "Southwestern Black Beans and Rice" by Wikibooks contributors (https://en.wikibooks.org/w/index.php?title=Cookbook%3ASouthwestern_Black_Beans_and_Rice&action=history), revision 4525238, CC BY-SA 4.0. Ingredient matching and nutrition added by LeanTrack.

ingredients.text: 10 ounce can tomatoes and green chiles

steps: In medium saucepan, combine beans, tomatoes and green chiles mix, and cumin.
Heat through.
Serve over hot rice.

recipes.title: Spiced Pumpkin Soup
recipes.attribution: "Spiced Pumpkin Soup" by Wikibooks contributors (https://en.wikibooks.org/w/index.php?title=Cookbook%3ASpiced_Pumpkin_Soup&action=history), revision 4523308, CC BY-SA 4.0. Ingredient matching and nutrition added by LeanTrack.

ingredients.text: 1 cup peeled and cubed sweet potato
2 cans (28 oz) nonfat and low-sodium chicken broth or vegetable stock

steps: Melt butter in a Dutch oven or large saucepan over medium-high heat. Sauté onion for 3–4 minutes. Add flour, curry, cumin, and nutmeg and sauté for 1 minute.

Add sweet potato, salt, chicken broth, and pumpkin, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer, partially covered for about 20–25 minutes or until sweet potatoes are cooked through and softened. Remove from heat and let stand for 10 minutes to cool.
Place half of the pumpkin mixture in a blender and process until smooth. Using a strainer, pour soup back into pan. Repeat with rest of soup.
Raise heat to medium then stir in milk and cook for 5 minutes or until soup is heated through.
Remove from heat and add lime juice.

recipes.title: Spicy Southern Barbecued Chicken
recipes.summary: Let yourself fall under the spell of this Southern style, sweet barbecue sauce.
recipes.source: NHLBI (NIH), Heart Healthy Home Cooking African American Style
recipes.license: Public domain (U.S. federal government work, 17 U.S.C. § 105)
recipes.attribution: Recipe from "Heart Healthy Home Cooking African American Style", National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute, National Institutes of Health.
steps: Combine all ingredients except chicken in a saucepan. Simmer for 15 minutes.
Place chicken on a large platter and brush it with half the sauce mixture.
Cover with plastic wrap and marinate in refrigerator for 1 hour.
Place chicken on a baking sheet lined with aluminum foil, and broil for 10 minutes on each side to seal in juices.
Remove from oven and brush chicken pieces with remaining sauce. Cover with aluminum foil and bake at 350 °F for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Spicy Tomato Soup
recipes.attribution: "Spicy Tomato Soup" by Wikibooks contributors (https://en.wikibooks.org/w/index.php?title=Cookbook%3ASpicy_Tomato_Soup&action=history), revision 4525247, CC BY-SA 4.0. Ingredient matching and nutrition added by LeanTrack.
steps: In a blender or food processor, working in batches if necessary, puree tomatoes, cream, sugar, pepper, salt, garlic and cayenne.
Transfer soup to a saucepan and bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce heat and simmer, stirring occasionally, until soup thickens, 20–30 minutes.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Spinach and Ricotta Lasagna
recipes.attribution: "Spinach and Ricotta Lasagna" by Wikibooks contributors (https://en.wikibooks.org/w/index.php?title=Cookbook%3ASpinach_and_Ricotta_Lasagna&action=history), revision 4605245, CC BY-SA 4.0. Ingredient matching and nutrition added by LeanTrack.

ingredients.text: 2 cans (56 oz) San Marzano or Roma tomatoes

ingredients.note: salt and pepper to taste (not measured)

steps: Put a thick-bottomed pot over medium-low heat. Add the oil and garlic, and stir until fragrant and blisters begin to form.
Add the tomatoes, and reduce the heat to low.
Simmer until it has a sauce consistency and has reduced to about ⅔ the original volume (about 1½ hours).
Turn off the heat and remove the garlic cloves to mash them with a fork. Add the garlic purée to the sauce.
Add salt to taste, cover, and let rest 30 minutes.
Pour the ricotta cheese onto a cheesecloth or tea towel in a strainer, and let drain for 30 minutes.
Combine the eggs and ricotta, and beat until creamy with a hand mixer.
Cover and reserve, ensuring it is at room temperature during assembly.
Thaw, drain, and press the liquid out of frozen spinach.
Reserve until ready to assemble.
Cook the pasta according to the manufacturer's directions, drain and place back into the pot with cold water.
Lay the sheets on a clean, wet tea towel and roll the cloth until ready to use.
Ladle sauce at the bottom of a 9x13-inch pan or dish and layer lasagna sheets.
Sparsely deposit spinach onto the noodles and apply cheese mixture with a rubber spatula.
Add more sauce and repeat the previous step until the pan is almost full and covered with a layer of lasagna.
Add sauce and cover with grated mozzarella.
Put the pan onto a tray and bake at 350°F for approximately 30 minutes, or to an internal temperature of 150°F.
Let rest for 15–20 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Spinach Mushroom Omelet
recipes.attribution: "Spinach Mushroom Omelet" by Wikibooks contributors (https://en.wikibooks.org/w/index.php?title=Cookbook%3ASpinach_Mushroom_Omelet&action=history), revision 4606145, CC BY-SA 4.0. Ingredient matching and nutrition added by LeanTrack.

ingredients.text: ⅔ cup baby bella mushrooms, thinly sliced
½ ea. large red onion, diced
½ cup shredded aged cheddar cheese

steps: In a large bowl, whisk the eggs, salt, pepper, nutmeg and milk, until even and glossy.
Heat the skillet over medium heat. Add half the butter, tilting the skillet in a circular motion to coat evenly.
Add paprika, mushrooms, and onions, and sauté until lightly browned.
Add spinach and toss for 30 seconds, or until slightly wilted, but still crunchy. Remove the vegetables from the heat and set aside.
Add the remaining half of the oil or butter to the pan over medium heat, and coat evenly. Lower the heat.
Pour the egg mixture into the skillet, swirling the pan to ensure an even, creamy layer of eggs. Heat until the eggs have begun to set, with some fluff on top.
Top the egg layer with the vegetables, distributing the vegetables evenly. Sprinkle the cheese evenly on top.
Gently push the edges of the omelet half a centimeter toward the center of the skillet with two spatulas, making sure not to break it. Turn the heat off.
Use the spatulas to carefully lift/pull half the omelet off the skillet and fold it over the other half. Carefully move the entire omelet onto a plate and serve.

recipes.title: Strawberry Banana Yogurt Parfait
recipes.summary: This nutritious treat will add color and joy to your celebrations.
recipes.source: NHLBI (NIH), Delicious Heart Healthy Latino Recipes
recipes.license: Public domain (U.S. federal government work, 17 U.S.C. § 105)
recipes.attribution: Recipe from "Delicious Heart Healthy Latino Recipes", National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute, National Institutes of Health.

ingredients.text: 2 C fresh strawberries, sliced (or use thawed frozen fruit)

steps: Spoon 1 tablespoon of yogurt into the bottom of each 8-ounce wine or parfait glass. Top the yogurt with 1 tablespoon sliced bananas, 1 tablespoon sliced strawberries, and ¼ cup graham cracker crumbs.
Repeat the yogurt, banana, strawberry, and graham cracker layers.
Top with a rounded tablespoon of fat-free whipped topping, if desired.
Serve the parfait immediately, or cover each glass with plastic wrap and chill for up to 2 hours before serving.

recipes.title: Summer Breeze Smoothie
recipes.summary: Here’s a perfect low-fat thirst quencher.
recipes.source: NHLBI (NIH), Heart Healthy Home Cooking African American Style
recipes.license: Public domain (U.S. federal government work, 17 U.S.C. § 105)
recipes.attribution: Recipe from "Heart Healthy Home Cooking African American Style", National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute, National Institutes of Health.

ingredients.text: 1 C pineapple, crushed, canned in juice

steps: Place all ingredients in blender, and puree until smooth.
Serve in frosted glasses.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Custard
recipes.summary: A flavorful custard that's tasty and healthy.
recipes.license: Public domain (U.S. federal government work, 17 U.S.C. § 105)
recipes.attribution: Recipe from "Stay Young At Heart", National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute, National Institutes of Health.

ingredients.text: 2 beaten egg yolks (or ⅓ C egg substitute; if using egg substitite, cholesterol will be lower)

steps: Preheat oven to 325 °F. Spray a 1-quart casserole with nonstick cooking spray.
In a medium bowl, stir together sweet potato and banana. Add milk, blending well.
Add brown sugar, egg yolks, and salt, and mix thoroughly.
Transfer sweet potato mixture to casserole dish.
Combine raisins, sugar, and cinnamon; sprinkle over the top of the sweet potato mixture.
Bake for 40 to 45 minutes, or until a knife inserted near the center comes out clean.

recipes.title: Tadka Dhal (Spiced Lentil Curry) II
recipes.attribution: "Tadka Dhal (Spiced Lentil Curry) II" by Wikibooks contributors (https://en.wikibooks.org/w/index.php?title=Cookbook%3ATadka_Dhal_(Spiced_Lentil_Curry)_II&action=history), revision 4615201, CC BY-SA 4.0. Ingredient matching and nutrition added by LeanTrack.

ingredients.text: 1 small sliver of ginger, chopped, or ¼ teaspoon ginger paste
¼ teaspoon red chilli (hot pepper) powder

steps: Set the dhal and water in an open pot on moderate heat until quite mushy, adding water if it becomes dry and stirring occasionally. This may take 30 minutes to an hour. A pressure cooker may be used to speed up this part of the process; this should take about 10–12 minutes at 5 psi.
Heat the oil in a pan. Add mustard seed, standing well back (they tend to spatter).
Add cumin seed, fenugreek, curry leaves, green chillies and onions

Wait for the onions to turn translucent. Add garlic and ginger, turn the heat low until the garlic changes to a darker shade. Avoid caramelizing the garlic. Add turmeric, red chilli and asafoetida powder.

Throw in tomatoes, and wait for 2–3 minutes, letting the tomatoes fry in the hot oil. This lets the tomatoes pick up the flavors from the spices and also lets the oil-spice (tadka) mixture cool down, stopping the hot frying process that has chilli powder in it. Pour in the mushy dhal, addding salt to taste.
Simmer until the tomatoes become soft (5–10 minutes), stirring occasionally.
Serve with rice or chapatis.

recipes.title: Tea Eggs
recipes.attribution: "Tea Eggs" by Wikibooks contributors (https://en.wikibooks.org/w/index.php?title=Cookbook%3ATea_Eggs&action=history), revision 4523484, CC BY-SA 4.0. Ingredient matching and nutrition added by LeanTrack.
steps: Bring water and spices to a boil.
Add eggs, and boil for 3 minutes.
Remove eggs from the liquid and roll them gently on a hard surface to crack the shell all over.
Return the eggs to the pot of liquid, reduce to a simmer, and simmer for 1 hour.
Reduce to low heat and allow eggs to sit in brine until served.

recipes.title: Teriyaki Grilled Salmon Steaks
recipes.attribution: "Teriyaki Grilled Salmon Steaks" by Wikibooks contributors (https://en.wikibooks.org/w/index.php?title=Cookbook%3ATeriyaki_Grilled_Salmon_Steaks&action=history), revision 4508862, CC BY-SA 4.0. Ingredient matching and nutrition added by LeanTrack.
steps: Season salmon with pepper.
Combine remaining ingredients to make teriyaki marinade.
Place on hot grill, and cook for 3–4 minutes on each side until flaky. Glaze with teriyaki marinade for the last 2 minutes.
Serve and enjoy.

recipes.title: Thai Grilled Chicken I
recipes.attribution: "Thai Grilled Chicken I" by Wikibooks contributors (https://en.wikibooks.org/w/index.php?title=Cookbook%3AThai_Grilled_Chicken_I&action=history), revision 4511528, CC BY-SA 4.0. Ingredient matching and nutrition added by LeanTrack.

ingredients.text: 1 tsp (5 ml) Thai chile paste (Sriracha recommended)
4 ea. (24 ounces / 680 g) boneless skinless chicken breasts
A flame-resistant towel tied into a roll with twine and soaked in oil
ingredients.note: not food (used to oil the grill)

steps: In a blender, purée the chiles, chile paste, sauces, garlic, ginger, and vinegar until smooth. Pour into a gallon-size zip-top bag and add chicken breasts. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
Heat a grill to medium heat. Quickly swab the grill with the towel and add chicken breasts. Cook 4–6 minutes per side or until internal temperature reaches 165°F (75 °C).
Remove to a plate and let rest 5 minutes. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Three Bean Confetti Salad
recipes.attribution: "Three Bean Confetti Salad" by Wikibooks contributors (https://en.wikibooks.org/w/index.php?title=Cookbook%3AThree_Bean_Confetti_Salad&action=history), revision 4525552, CC BY-SA 4.0. Ingredient matching and nutrition added by LeanTrack.

ingredients.text: 1 can (15 oz) pinto beans, rinsed and drained
1 can (15 oz) red kidney beans, rinsed and drained
1 can (12 oz) black beans, rinsed and drained
1 can (8¾ oz) whole kernel corn, drained
1 can (14½ oz) diced tomatoes with roasted garlic, undrained
½ cup fat-free Italian salad dressing

ingredients.note: dried herb blend not in USDA data (negligible)

steps: In a bowl, mix together beans, corn, tomatoes, Italian salad dressing, Italian seasoning and pepper.
Serve chilled or at room temperature.

recipes.title: Tropical Fruit Compote
recipes.summary: Fresh or cooked fruits make a great low-calorie dessert.
recipes.license: Public domain (U.S. federal government work, 17 U.S.C. § 105)
recipes.attribution: Recipe from "Stay Young At Heart", National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute, National Institutes of Health.

ingredients.note: a strip of lemon peel for flavor (negligible)

ingredients.text: ½ tsp rum or vanilla extract (optional)
1 pineapple, cored and peeled, cut into 8 slices
2 mangos, peeled and pitted, cut into 8 pieces
3 bananas, peeled, cut into 8 diagonal pieces

steps: In a saucepan combine ¾ cup of water with the sugar, lemon juice, and lemon peel (and rum or vanilla extract if desired). Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and add the fruit. Cook at a very low heat for 5 minutes.
Pour the syrup into a cup and set aside. Remove the lemon peel and cool the cooked fruit for 2 hours.
To serve the compote, arrange the fruit in a serving dish and pour a few teaspoons of syrup over the fruit. Garnish with mint leaves (if desired).

recipes.title: Tuna Noodle Casserole
recipes.attribution: "Tuna Noodle Casserole" by Wikibooks contributors (https://en.wikibooks.org/w/index.php?title=Cookbook%3ATuna_Noodle_Casserole&action=history), revision 4525571, CC BY-SA 4.0. Ingredient matching and nutrition added by LeanTrack.

ingredients.text: 2 cans (drained) or pouches (12 ounces each) tuna
4 cups hot, cooked medium egg noodles
2 cans (21 ounces) condensed cream of mushroom soup
¼–1 teaspoon Texas Pete or other hot sauce (optional)
3–4 ounces cheese, shredded or sliced to cover casserole

steps: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Shred tuna and stir into 3-quart casserole with milk, noodles, peas, and soup. Add onions and hot sauce if desired.
Bake until hot, about 25–30 minutes.
Remove from oven, and top with bread crumbs mixed with butter or with cheese.
Bake another 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Turkey and Beef Meatballs with Whole-Wheat Spaghetti
recipes.summary: Easy and delicious!
recipes.license: Public domain (U.S. federal government work, 17 U.S.C. § 105)
recipes.attribution: Recipe from "Deliciously Healthy Family Meals", National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute, National Institutes of Health.
recipes.servingSize: 4 meatballs, ¾ C pasta, ½ C sauce, 1 tsp cheese, pinch of basil

ingredients.text: 1 Tbsp fresh basil, rinsed, dried, and chopped (or 1 tsp dried)
For turkey meatballs: 6 oz 99 percent lean ground turkey
½ Tbsp fresh chives, rinsed, dried, and chopped (or 1 tsp dried)
½ Tbsp fresh parsley, rinsed, dried, and chopped (or 1 tsp dried)
For beef meatballs: 6 oz 93 percent lean ground beef
½ Tbsp fresh chives, rinsed, dried, and chopped (or 1 tsp dried)
½ Tbsp fresh parsley, rinsed, dried, and chopped (or 1 tsp dried)

steps: Preheat oven to 400 ºF.
In a 4-quart saucepan, bring 3 quarts of water to a boil over high heat.
Add pasta, and cook according to package directions. Drain.

Meanwhile, combine ingredients for the turkey and beef meatballs in separate bowls, and mix well. Measure 1½ tablespoons of turkey mixture and roll in hand to form a ball; then place the meatball on a nonstick baking sheet. Repeat, and follow same instruction for beef mixture, until eight turkey and eight beef meatballs are made.
Bake meatballs on a nonstick baking sheet for 10 minutes (to a minimal internal temperature of 165 °F).
Warm sauce, if necessary.
Serve four meatballs, ¾ cup hot pasta, ½ cup sauce, 1 teaspoon cheese, and a pinch of basil per portion.
tips: Older children can help make the meatballs. Make sure everyone washes their hands and sanitizes all utensils and surfaces with disinfectant after handling raw meat.

recipes.title: Turkey Bolognese With Shell Pasta
recipes.summary: Anise seed makes turkey taste like Italian sausage, with none of the saturated fat; the red wine and dried mushrooms make this a uniquely delicious dish.
recipes.license: Public domain (U.S. federal government work, 17 U.S.C. § 105)
recipes.attribution: Recipe from "Deliciously Healthy Dinners", National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute, National Institutes of Health.

ingredients.text: ½ C celery, rinsed and chopped
1 C carrots, rinsed and thinly sliced or shredded
1 Tbsp garlic, pressed or finely chopped (about 2–3 cloves)

steps: Optional step: Bring the wine to a boil in a medium saucepan. Break up the mushrooms, then stir them into the wine. Cover, reduce heat, and simmer for 20 minutes.
Finely chop the onion, celery, carrots, and garlic. Or you can coarsely chop them, place them in a food processor, and pulse until all vegetables are finely chopped.
In a 4-quart saucepan, bring 3 quarts of water to a boil over high heat.

While the water is heating up, warm the olive oil in a large nonstick pan over medium-high heat. Crumble in the ground turkey. Sprinkle with anise seed and salt. Cook for 5–10 minutes to brown, stirring occasionally.
Meanwhile, when the water comes to a boil, add pasta to boiling water. Cook according to package directions for the shortest recommended time, about 10–12 minutes.

Add vegetables to cooking turkey. Reduce heat to medium. Cook and stir 10 minutes until all vegetables are soft, but not browned. And tomato paste, and simmer for an additional 5–10 minutes. (Continue to optional step 7 if including the optional ingredients; otherwise, skip to step 8.)

Optional step: While the pasta and turkey mixture cooks, strain mushrooms, draining unabsorbed wine directly into the turkey mixture. Place mushrooms on a cutting board and chop finely, or place in food processor and pulse once or twice to more finely chop mushrooms. Stir mushrooms into turkey mixture. Simmer for 10–15 minutes to blend flavors.
Drain pasta. Add pasta to turkey mixture (the minimum internal temperature of cooked turkey should be 165 °F). Stir to blend well.
Divide pasta mixture evenly (about 2 cups each) among four dinner plates. Top each with 2 tablespoons of shredded parmesan cheese.
tips: Serve with a side of sliced fresh tomatoes, cucumbers, and balsamic vinegar.

recipes.title: Turkey Club Burger
recipes.summary: Lighten up your traditional hamburger with lean ground turkey — less saturated fat, without less flavor.
recipes.license: Public domain (U.S. federal government work, 17 U.S.C. § 105)
recipes.attribution: Recipe from "Deliciously Healthy Dinners", National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute, National Institutes of Health.

ingredients.text: ½ C scallions (green onions), rinsed and sliced
4 oz spinach or arugula, rinsed and dried
4 oz portabella mushroom, rinsed, grilled or broiled, and sliced (optional)

steps: Preheat oven broiler on high temperature (with the rack 3 inches from heat source) or grill on medium-high heat.
To prepare burgers, combine ground turkey, scallions, pepper, and egg, and mix well. Form into ½- to ¾-inch thick patties, and coat each lightly with olive oil.
Broil or grill burgers for about 7–9 minutes on each side (to a minimum internal temperature of 160 °F).
Combine mayonnaise and mustard to make a spread.
Assemble ¾ tablespoon spread, 1 ounce spinach or arugula, several slices of grilled portabella mushroom (optional), and one burger on each bun.

recipes.title: Tuscan Bean Soup
recipes.attribution: "Tuscan Bean Soup" by Wikibooks contributors (https://en.wikibooks.org/w/index.php?title=Cookbook%3ATuscan_Bean_Soup&action=history), revision 4515570, CC BY-SA 4.0. Ingredient matching and nutrition added by LeanTrack.

ingredients.text: 1 cup spelt or wheat berries (available at gourmet-food shops)
¼ cup extra-virgin olive oil, plus more for drizzling
½ pound sweet Italian sausage, casings removed
1 pound kale, preferably Tuscan, coarse stems removed, cut into thick ribbons
1 large rib celery, trimmed and diced
5 cups homemade chicken stock, or canned low-sodium stock, plus more if needed
1 cup peeled, seeded, and diced tomatoes, or drained canned diced tomatoes
Sea salt and freshly ground pepper
ingredients.note: salt and pepper to taste (not measured)

ingredients.text: ½ cup freshly grated Parmigiano-Reggiano cheese

steps: Soak beans and spelt overnight in separate bowls of cold water.
Drain and set aside.
Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add sausage.
Cook stirring occasionally, until meat begins to separate and brown (3–5 minutes).
Stir in kale, onion, carrot, celery, and garlic.
Cook until softened (about 10 minutes).
Add beans, spelt, chicken stock, and tomatoes.
Bring to boil.
Stir in rosemary and sage.
Reduce heat.
Simmer mixture for 60–70 minutes, until beans are tender; if soup is too thick, add chicken stock.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.
Ladle soup into bowls.
Drizzle with olive oil, and sprinkle on cheese.
Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Tuscan Beans With Tomatoes and Oregano
recipes.summary: Dine outside on a warm summer evening with this cool and satisfying salad.
recipes.license: Public domain (U.S. federal government work, 17 U.S.C. § 105)
recipes.attribution: Recipe from "Deliciously Healthy Dinners", National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute, National Institutes of Health.

ingredients.text: 1 can (15½ oz) low-sodium chickpeas (or garbanzo beans), drained and rinsed
2 C cherry tomatoes, rinsed and halved
2 Tbsp fresh oregano, minced (or 1 teaspoon dried)
4 whole inner leaves of romaine lettuce, rinsed and dried

steps: In a large salad bowl, combine beans and tomatoes.

In a small bowl, combine olive oil, vinegar, oregano, pepper, and salt-free seasoning blend. Using a wire whisk, beat the ingredients until they blend into one thick sauce at the point where the oil and vinegar no longer separate.
Pour the dressing over the beans and tomatoes, and mix gently to coat.
Line four salad bowls with one romaine lettuce leaf each.
Top each leaf with one-fourth of the bean mixture, and serve.

recipes.title: Vegetable Stew
recipes.summary: Here’s a great new way to use summer vegetables.
recipes.source: NHLBI (NIH), Heart Healthy Home Cooking African American Style
recipes.license: Public domain (U.S. federal government work, 17 U.S.C. § 105)
recipes.attribution: Recipe from "Heart Healthy Home Cooking African American Style", National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute, National Institutes of Health.

ingredients.text: 2 C white potatoes, cut into 2-inch strips
4 C summer squash, cut into 1-inch squares
1 C summer squash, cut into 4 large chunks
1 can (15 oz) sweet corn, rinsed and drained (or 2 ears fresh corn, 1½ C)

steps: Put water and bouillon in a large pot, and bring to a boil.
Add potatoes and carrots, and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add remaining ingredients, except for tomatoes, and continue cooking for 15 minutes over medium heat.
Remove the four large chunks of squash and puree in a blender. Return pureed mixture to the pot, and let cook for 10 minutes more.
Add tomatoes and cook for another 5 minutes.
Remove from heat and let sit for 10 minutes to allow stew to thicken before serving.

recipes.title: Vegetarian Soft Tacos

ingredients.text: 1 pound ground beef substitute (e.g. MorningStar Farms Grillers Recipe Crumbles)

ingredients.note: amount not given in the source (not counted)

steps: In a frying pan brown onions on medium-low heat.
Add garlic, chilli powder, paprika, salt, and red pepper. Stir and cook for 1 minute.
Add beef substitute and water. Cook for 10–15 minutes until most of the water is gone.
Meanwhile chop and shred the toppings as needed. Put toppings in bowls on table.
Start to warm refried beans in a small pot.
Heat another frying pan on medium-low heat.
Put vegetarian taco meat and refried beans in bowls and place on table.
Put floured tortilla in pan and lightly brown both sides. As tortillas are ready allow guests to select their own toppings.

recipes.title: Vietnamese Fresh Spring Rolls (Gỏi Cuốn)
recipes.summary: Quick and refreshing — the perfect appetizer.
recipes.source: NHLBI (NIH), Your Health Is Golden! Heart Health Promotion Activities for Vietnamese Communities
recipes.license: Public domain (U.S. federal government work, 17 U.S.C. § 105)

ingredients.text: 1 C carrots, cut into long, thin strips
2 C cucumber, seeded and cut into long, thin strips

steps: Toss first six ingredients in a large bowl.
Soak one rice paper wrapper in warm water until soft (1 to 2 minutes). Shake off excess water.
Place vegetable filling off-center on rice paper, and fold like an egg roll (tuck in the sides to keep the filling inside).
Repeat with remaining vegetable filling and rice paper wrappers.
Once you have assembled all of the spring rolls, serve immediately.

recipes.title: Wiki (Fast) Rice
recipes.summary: Wiki means "fast" in Hawaiian, and this dish fits the bill—it's quick and easy to make.
recipes.license: Public domain (U.S. federal government work, 17 U.S.C. § 105)
recipes.attribution: Recipe from "Deliciously Healthy Family Meals", National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute, National Institutes of Health.

ingredients.text: 1 Tbsp fresh garlic, minced (about 3 cloves) (or 1 tsp dried)
1 tsp fresh ginger, minced (or ¼ tsp dried)
1 Tbsp scallions (green onions), rinsed and minced
½ C canned sliced water chestnuts, drained
2 C cooked mixed vegetables (or ½ bag frozen stir-fry vegetable mix) (Leftover Friendly)

steps: Heat canola oil in a large wok or sauté pan over medium heat. Add garlic, ginger, and scallions, and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add water chestnuts, and continue to cook until they begin to soften, another 1–2 minutes.
Add vegetables, and toss until heated through, about 2–3 minutes (or up to 5 minutes for frozen vegetables).
Add rice, and continue to cook until hot, about 3–5 minutes.
Add soy sauce and sesame oil. Toss well, and serve.
tips: This recipe tastes best when prepared using leftover cold rice.

steps: Soak split peas up to six hours in cold water if you wish. This is not necessary, but will shorten cooking time.

recipes.title: Zucchini Bread
recipes.attribution: "Zucchini Bread" by Wikibooks contributors (https://en.wikibooks.org/w/index.php?title=Cookbook%3AZucchini_Bread&action=history), revision 4502092, CC BY-SA 4.0. Ingredient matching and nutrition added by LeanTrack.
steps: Grease and flour two 8 x 4-inch loaf pans. Preheat oven to 325°F.
Sift together flour, salt, baking powder, baking soda, and cinnamon in a bowl.
Beat eggs, oil, vanilla, and sugar together in a large bowl.
Add sifted ingredients to the creamed mixture, and beat well. Stir in zucchini until well combined.
Pour batter into prepared pans.
Bake for 40 minutes to 1 hour, or until tester inserted into the center comes out clean.
Cool in pan for 20 minutes. Remove from pan and completely cool.
